54.fa: امام صادق (- اسماعیل پیغمبر خدا با مردی در گوشه‌ی بیابان وعده کرد و یک سال در آنجا انتظار کشید و مردم مکّه جویایش بودند و نمی‌دانستند کجا است؛ تا مردی به او برخورد و گفت: «ای پیغمبر خدا! پس از تو ناتوان و هلاک شدیم». فرمود: «فلانی - که معلوم الحال بود - به من وعده داد که اینجا بنشینم و من تکان نمی‌خورم تا او بیاید». مردم به سوی آن شخص رفتند و به او گفتند: «ای دشمن خدا! به پیغمبر وعده دادی و خلف وعده کردی»؟ و آن مرد آمد و به اسماعیل (گفت: «ای پیامبر خدا! یادم نیامد و فراموش کردم». فرمود: «به خدا اگر نمی‌آمدی، کار به محشر می‌کشید. و خدا فرو فرستاد: وَ اذْکُرْ فِی الْکِتابِ إِسْماعیلَ إِنَّهُ کانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ.
54.en: Ishmael, the Prophet of God, made a promise to a man at al-Sifah. He remained there for a year, waiting, while the people of Mecca searched for him, not knowing where he was. Eventually, a man came upon him and said, "O Prophet of God, we have become weak and perished after you." He replied, "A certain man from Ta'if promised me that I would be here, and I will not depart until he arrives." The people went to that man and said to him, "O enemy of God, you made a promise to the Prophet and then broke it!" The man came and said to Ishmael (peace be upon him), "O Prophet of God, I did not remember; I forgot our appointment." He replied, "By God, had you not come to me, the gathering [for this matter] would have been on the Day of Resurrection." Then God revealed: "And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise."
54.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 90
54.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 13, p. 390; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Rawandi, p. 189; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 8, p. 458; Nur al-Thaqalayn (with variations).

54.ar: عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ أَبِی الْحَمْسَاءِ قَالَ کَانَ بَیْنِی وَ بَیْنَ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) بَیْعٌ قَبْلَ أَنْ یُبْعَثَ فَبَقِیَتْ لِی بَقِیَّةٌ فَوَعَدْتُهُ أَنْ آتِیَهُ فِی مَکَانِهِ فَنَسِیتُ یَوْمِی وَ الْغَدَ فَأَتَیْتُهُ فِی الْیَوْمِ الثَّالِثِ وَ کَانَ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فِی مَکَانِهِ یَنْتَظِرُنِی فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فِی ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ أَنَا هَاهُنَا مُذْ وَعَدْتُکَ أَنْتَظِرُکَ ضَاهَی جَدَّهُ إِسْمَاعِیلَ بْنَ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (علیه السلام) فَإِنَّهُ وَعَدَ رَجُلًا فَبَقِیَ فِی مَکَانِهِ سَنَةً فَشَکَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ ذَلِکَ فَقَالَ وَ اذْکُرْ فِی الْکِتابِ إِسْماعِیلَ إِنَّهُ کانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ.
54.fa: پیامبر (- عبداللَّه‌بن‌ابی الحمساء می‌گوید: قبل از بعثت، بین من و محمّد (داد و ستدی بود، مقداری طلبکار شدم به او گفتم: «همین‌جا باش و من بر می‌گردم. آن روز و روز بعد، فراموش کردم که برگردم. پس در روز سوّم نزد او آمدم و دیدم که او همان‌جا منتظر من است». برای او جریان را گفتم [که فراموش کردم] فرمود: «من سه روز است که اینجا منتظر شما هستم، مانند جدّش حضرت اسماعیل (که وقتی در جایی به مردی وعده داد، یک سال در آنجا منتظر ماند، خدای متعال به خاطر این عمل، از او قدردانی می‌کند و می‌فرماید: وَ اذْکُرْ فِی الْکِتابِ إِسْماعیلَ إِنَّهُ کانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ.
54.en: Abdullah ibn Abi al-Hamsa’ said: "Before he was commissioned [as a Prophet], there was a transaction between me and Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and a portion remained outstanding. I promised him that I would come to him at that location, but I forgot for that day and the next. When I came to him on the third day, Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was in his place waiting for me. I spoke to him about it, and he said: 'I have been here since I promised you, waiting for you.' He resembled his forefather, Ishmael son of Abraham (peace be upon him), for he had promised a man [to meet him] and remained in his place for a year, so God thanked him for that and said: 'And mention in the Book, Ishmael; indeed, he was true to his promise.'"
54.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 90

55.ar: وَ عَنْهُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَنَّهُ قَالَ: لَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ یا أَیُّهَا الَّذِینَ آمَنُوا قُوا أَنْفُسَکُمْ وَ أَهْلِیکُمْ ناراً قَالَ النَّاسُ یَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) کَیْفَ نَقِی أَنْفُسَنَا وَ أَهْلِینَا قَالَ اعْمَلُوا الْخَیْرَ وَ ذَکِّرُوا بِهِ أَهْلِیکُمْ فَأَدِّبُوهُمْ عَلَی طَاعَةِ اللَّهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَبُوعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) أَ لَا تَرَی أَنَّ اللَّهَ یَقُولُ لِنَبِیِّهِ وَ أْمُرْ أَهْلَکَ بِالصَّلاةِ وَ اصْطَبِرْ عَلَیْها وَ قَالَ وَ اذْکُرْ فِی الْکِتابِ إِسْماعِیلَ إِنَّهُ کانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَ کانَ رَسُولًا نَبِیًّا وَ کانَ یَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلاةِ وَ الزَّکاةِ وَ کانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِیًّا.
55.en: It is narrated from him (peace be upon him and his family) that he said: When this verse was revealed, "O you who believe! Protect yourselves and your families from a Fire," the people asked, "O Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), how do we protect ourselves and our families?" He replied, "Perform good deeds and remind your families of them, and discipline them in the obedience of Allah." Then Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said, "Do you not see that Allah says to His Prophet, 'And enjoin prayer upon your family and be steadfast therein' (Ta-Ha/132)? And He also said, 'And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet. And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakat and was to his Lord pleasing.'"
55.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 90
55.refs: Da'a'im al-Islam, Vol. 1, p. 82; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 12, p. 201; "Anfusakum" instead of "Anfakum"

55.ar: رُوِیَ أَنَّهُ ذُکِرَ عِنْدَ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) رَجُلَانِ کَانَ أَحَدُهُمَا یُصَلِّی الْمَکْتُوبَةَ وَ یَجْلِسُ فَیُعَلِّمُ النَّاسَ الْخَیْرَ وَ کَانَ الْآخَرُ یَصُومُ النَّهَارَ وَ یَقُومُ اللَّیْلَ فَقَالَ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَضْلُ الْأَوَّلِ عَلَی الثَّانِی کَفَضْلِی عَلَی الْأَنَامِ وَ قَدْ أَثْنَی اللَّهُ تَعَالَی عَلَی إِسْمَاعِیلَ بِقَوْلِهِ إِنَّهُ کانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَ کانَ رَسُولًا نَبِیًّا. وَ کانَ یَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلاةِ وَ الزَّکاةِ وَ کانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِیًّا.
55.fa: پیامبر (- در نزد پیغمبر (ذکر شد: «دو نفر هستند که یکی از آن دو نماز واجب خود را به جا می‌آورد و می‌نشیند و آنچه خیر مردم در آن است به آن‌ها یاد می‌دهد از قبیل مسائل فقهی یا اخلاقی یا اعتقادی یا آداب معاشرت و حقوق و امثال این‌ها، و آن دیگری روزها روزه است و شب‌ها به عبادت قیام می‌کند و به‌این‌حال اوقات این دو نفر طی می‌گردد، کدام یک افضل است»؟ رسول خدا (فرمود: «آن شخص اوّلی که به واجبات اکتفا می‌کند و مشغول تعلیم مردم است فضیلتش بر دوّمی مانند فضیلت من است بر مردم دیگر. به‌تحقیق خداوند حضرت اسماعیل (صادق‌الوعد را در قرآن کریم مدح کرده و فرموده: إِنَّهُ کانَ صادِقَ الْوَعْدِ وَ کانَ رَسُولًا نَبِیًّا* وَ کانَ یَأْمُرُ أَهْلَهُ بِالصَّلاةِ وَ الزَّکاةِ وَ کانَ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِ مَرْضِیًّا.
55.en: It is narrated that two men were mentioned in the presence of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). One of them would perform the obligatory prayers and then sit to teach people what is good, while the other would fast during the day and stand in prayer during the night. The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The superiority of the first over the second is like my superiority over all of mankind." Indeed, God Almighty praised Ishmael by saying: "He was true to his promise, and he was a messenger, a prophet. He used to enjoin prayer and almsgiving upon his people, and he was pleasing to his Lord."
55.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 92

56.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی غَضِبَ عَلَی مَلَکٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ فَقَطَعَ جَنَاحَهُ وَ أَلْقَاهُ فِی جَزِیرَةٍ مِنْ جَزَائِرِ الْبَحْرِ فَبَقِیَ مَا شَاءَ اللَّهُ فِی ذَلِکَ الْبَحْرِ فَلَمَّا بَعَثَ اللَّهُ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) جَاءَ ذَلِکَ الْمَلَکُ إِلَیْهِ فَقَالَ یَا نَبِیَّ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) ادْعُ اللَّهَ أَنْ یَرْضَی عَنِّی وَ یَرُدَّ عَلَیَّ جَنَاحِی قَالَ نَعَمْ فَدَعَا إِدْرِیسُ رَبَّهُ فَرَدَّ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ جَنَاحَهُ وَ رَضِیَ عَنْهُ قَالَ الْمَلَکُ لِإِدْرِیسَ أَ لَکَ إِلَیَّ حَاجَةٌ قَالَ نَعَمْ أُحِبُّ أَنْ تَرْفَعَنِی إِلَی السَّمَاءِ حَتَّی أَنْظُرَ إِلَی مَلَکِ الْمَوْتِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا تَعَیُّشَ لِی مَعَ ذِکْرِهِ فَأَخَذَهُ الْمَلَکُ إِلَی جَنَاحِهِ حَتَّی انْتَهَی بِهِ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ فَإِذَا مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ جَالِسٌ یُحَرِّکُ رَأْسَهُ تَعَجُّباً فَسَلَّمَ إِدْرِیسُ عَلَی مَلَکِ الْمَوْتِ وَ قَالَ لَهُ مَا لَکَ تُحَرِّکُ رَأْسَکَ قَالَ إِنَّ رَبَّ الْعِزَّةِ أَمَرَنِی أَنْ أَقْبِضَ رُوحَکَ بَیْنَ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ الْخَامِسَةِ فَقُلْتُ رَبِّ کَیْفَ یَکُونُ هَذَا وَ غِلَظُ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ وَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ الثَّالِثَةِ مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ وَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ الثَّالِثَةِ إِلَی الثَّانِیَةِ مَسِیرَةُ خَمْسِمِائَةِ عَامٍ وَ کُلُّ سَمَاءٍ وَ مَا بَیْنَهُمَا کَذَلِکَ فَکَیْفَ یَکُونُ هَذَا ثُمَّ قَبَضَ رُوحَهُ بَیْنَ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ الْخَامِسَةِ وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ وَ رَفَعْناهُ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا قَالَ وَ سُمِّیَ إِدْرِیسَ لِکَثْرَةِ دِرَاسَةِ الْکُتُبِ.
56.fa: امام صادق (- همانا خداوند تبارک‌وتعالی بر یکی از فرشتگان خشم گرفت و بال‌هایش را قطع کرد و آن را در یکی از جزایر دریا انداخت و تا زمانی‌که اراده کرد، او را در آنجا نگه داشت و هنگامی‌که خداوند ادریس (را برانگیخت، آن فرشته نزد او آمد و گفت: «ای پیامبر خدا (! از خداوند بخواه که از من راضی گردد و بال‌هایم را به من بازگرداند». ادریس (گفت: «باشد، دعا میکنم». سپس برایش دعا کرد و خداوند نیز بال‌هایش را به او بازگرداند و از او راضی گشت. فرشته به ادریس (گفت: «از من درخواستی داری»؟ ادریس (گفت: «آری، می‌خواهم مرا به آسمان ببری تا فرشته‌ی مرگ را ببینم، چرا که با یاد او زندگی بر من ناخوش می‌گردد». سپس فرشته، ادریس (را بر روی بالش گذاشت تا اینکه به آسمان چهارم رسید و ناگهان دید که فرشته‌ی مرگ از تعجّب، سرش را تکان می‌دهد. ادریس (به او سلام کرد و گفت: «چه شده است که سرت را تکان می‌دهی»؟ او گفت: «همانا پروردگار بزرگ به من دستور داده تا جانت را بین آسمان چهارم و پنجم بگیرم». من گفتم: «پروردگارا! چگونه این ممکن است و حال آنکه ضخامت آسمان چهارم به‌اندازه‌ی مسیر پانصدسال و از آسمان چهارم تا سوّم نیز مسیر پانصدسال است و ضخامت آسمان سوّم و مسافت بین آسمان سوّم تا آسمان دوّم نیز هرکدام مسیر پانصدسال است و هر آسمانی و مسافت بین آن‌ها نیز همین‌مقدار فاصله دارد، حال چگونه این ممکن است»؟ سپس روح ادریس (را بین آسمان چهارم و پنجم گرفت و منظور از آیه: وَرَفَعْنَاهُ مَکَانًا عَلِیًّا نیز همین است. همچنین آن حضرت فرمود: «او را ادریس (نامیدند چون بسیار کتاب می‌خواند».
56.en: Verily, Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, became angry with one of the angels, so He severed his wing and cast him onto an island in the sea. He remained in that sea for as long as Allah willed. When Allah raised Idris (peace be upon him), that angel came to him and said, "O Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), pray to Allah that He may be pleased with me and restore my wing to me." He said, "Yes." So Idris prayed to his Lord, and Allah restored his wing to him and was pleased with him. The angel said to Idris, "Do you have a request of me?" He said, "Yes, I would like you to raise me to the heaven so that I may look at the Angel of Death, for there is no life for me with the thought of him." The angel took him upon his wing until he reached the fourth heaven, and there was the Angel of Death, sitting and shaking his head in astonishment. Idris greeted the Angel of Death and said to him, "Why are you shaking your head?" He replied, "Verily, the Lord of Might has commanded me to take your soul between the fourth and fifth heavens. I said, 'My Lord, how can this be, when the thickness of the fourth heaven is a journey of five hundred years, and from the fourth heaven to the third heaven is a journey of five hundred years, and from the third heaven to the second is a journey of five hundred years, and every heaven and the space between them is likewise? How then can this be?'" Then he took his soul between the fourth and fifth heavens, and this is the meaning of His saying: "And We raised him to a high station." He (the Imam) said: "He was named Idris because of his frequent study (dirasah) of the scriptures."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 92
56.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 11, p. 277; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 51; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Jaza'iri, p. 63; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan

56.ar: ثُمَ صَعِدْنَا إِلَی السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ إِذَا فِیهَا رَجُلٌ، قُلْتُ مَنْ هَذَا یَا جَبْرَئِیلُ قَالَ هَذَا إِدْرِیسُ رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا فَسَلَّمْتُ عَلَیْهِ وَ سَلَّمَ عَلَیَّ وَ اسْتَغْفَرْتُ لَهُ وَ اسْتَغْفَرَ لِی.
56.fa: پیامبر (- ... سپس به آسمان چهارم رفتم و در آنجا مردی را دیدم و گفتم: «این کیست، ای جبرئیل»؟ گفت: «این ادریس (است که خداوند او را به مقامی بلند ارتقا داد». سپس به او سلام کردم و او نیز به من سلام کرد. من برای او طلب استغفار کردم.
56.en: Then we ascended to the fourth heaven, and there was a man in it. I said, "Who is this, O Gabriel?" He said, "This is Idris, whom Allah raised to a high station." I greeted him, and he greeted me back. I sought forgiveness for him, and he sought forgiveness for me.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 92

56.ar: کَانَ إِدْرِیسُ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) یَسِیحُ النَّهَارَ وَ یَصُومُهُ وَ یَبِیتُ حَیْثُ مَا جَنَّهُ اللَّیْلُ وَ یَأْتِیهِ رِزْقُهُ حَیْثُ مَا أَفْطَرَ وَ کَانَ یَصْعَدُ لَهُ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ الصَّالِحِ مِثْلُ مَا یَصْعَدُ لِأَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ کُلِّهِمْ فَسَأَلَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ رَبَّهُ فِی زِیَارَةِ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) وَ أَنْ یُسَلِّمَ عَلَیْهِ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ فَنَزَلَ وَ أَتَاهُ فَقَالَ إِنِّی أُرِیدُ أَنْ أَصْحَبَکَ فَأَکُونَ مَعَکَ فَصَحِبَهُ وَ کَانَا یَسِیحَانِ النَّهَارَ وَ یَصُومَانِهِ فَإِذَا جَنَّهُمَا اللَّیْلُ أُتِیَ إِدْرِیسَ فِطْرُهُ فَیَأْکُلُ وَ یَدْعُو مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ إِلَیْهِ فَیَقُولُ لَا حَاجَةَ لِی فِیهِ ثُمَّ یَقُومَان یُصَلِّیَانِ وَ إِدْرِیسُ یُصَلِّی وَ یَفْتُرُ وَ یَنَامُ وَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ یُصَلِّی وَ لَا یَنَامُ وَ لَا یَفْتُرُ فَمَکَثَا بِذَلِکَ أیام {أَیَّاماً} ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمَا مَرَّا بِقَطِیعِ غَنَمٍ وَ کَرْمٍ قَدْ أَیْنَعَ فَقَالَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ هَلْ لَکَ أَنْ تَأْخُذَ مِنْ ذَلِکَ حَمَلًا أَوْ مِنْ هَذَا عَنَاقِیدَ فَتُفْطِرَ عَلَیْهِ فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ أَدْعُوکَ إِلَی مَالِی فَتَأْبَی فَکَیْفَ تَدْعُونِی إِلَی مَالِ الْغَیْرِ ثُمَّ قَالَ إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) قَدْ صَحِبْتَنِی وَ أَحْسَنْتَ فِیمَا بَیْنِی وَ بَیْنَکَ مَنْ أَنْتَ قَالَ أَنَا مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ قَالَ إِدْرِیسُ لِی إِلَیْکَ حَاجَةٌ فَقَالَ وَ مَا هِیَ قَالَ تَصْعَدُ بِی إِلَی السَّمَاءِ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ رَبَّهُ فِی ذَلِکَ فَأَذِنَ لَهُ فَحَمَلَهُ عَلَی جَنَاحِهِ فَصَعِدَ بِهِ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) إِنَّ لِی إِلَیْکَ حَاجَةً أُخْرَی قَالَ وَ مَا هِیَ قَالَ بَلَغَنِی مِنَ الْمَوْتِ شِدَّةٌ فَأُحِبُّ أَنْ تُذِیقَنِی مِنْهُ طَرَفاً فَأَنْظُرَ هُوَ کَمَا بَلَغَنِی فَاسْتَأْذَنَ رَبَّهُ لَهُ فَأَخَذَ بِنَفْسِهِ سَاعَةً ثُمَّ خَلَّی عَنْهُ فَقَالَ لَهُ کَیْفَ رَأَیْتَ قَالَ بَلَغَنِی عَنْهُ شِدَّةٌ وَ إِنَّهُ لَأَشَدُّ مِمَّا بَلَغَنِی وَ لِی إِلَیْکَ حَاجَةٌ أُخْرَی تُرِینِی النَّارَ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ صَاحِبَ النَّارِ فَفَتَحَ لَهُ فَلَمَّا رَآهَا إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) سَقَطَ مَغْشِیّاً عَلَیْهِ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُ لِی إِلَیْکَ حَاجَةٌ أُخْرَی تُرِینِی الْجَنَّةَ فَاسْتَأْذَنَ مَلَکُ الْمَوْتِ خَازِنَ الْجَنَّةِ فَدَخَلَهَا فَلَمَّا نَظَرَ إِلَیْهَا قَالَ یَا مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ مَا کُنْتُ لِأَخْرُجَ مِنْهَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَعَالَی یَقُولُ کُلُّ نَفْسٍ ذائِقَةُ الْمَوْتِ وَ قَدْ ذُقْتُهُ وَ یَقُولُ وَ إِنْ مِنْکُمْ إِلَّا وارِدُها وَ قَدْ وَرَدْتُهَا وَ یَقُولُ فِی الْجَنَّةِ وَ ما هُمْ بِخارِجِینَ مِنْها.
56.en: The Prophet Idris (peace be upon him) would spend his days in devotion and fasting, and he would spend the night wherever darkness overtook him. His sustenance would come to him wherever he broke his fast. His righteous deeds were equivalent to the righteous deeds of all the people of the earth combined. The Angel of Death asked his Lord for permission to visit Idris (peace be upon him) and to greet him, and He granted it. He descended and came to him, saying, "I wish to accompany you and be with you." So he accompanied him, and they would spend the days in devotion and fasting. When night fell, Idris’s food would be brought to him, and he would eat and invite the Angel of Death to join him, but he would say, "I have no need for it." Then they would stand to pray. Idris would pray, grow weary, and sleep, while the Angel of Death would pray without sleeping or growing weary. They remained like this for several days. Then, they passed by a flock of sheep and a vineyard that had ripened. The Angel of Death said, "Would you like to take a lamb from this or some clusters of grapes from that to break your fast with?" Idris said, "Glory be to God! I invite you to my own property and you refuse, yet you invite me to the property of another?" Then Idris (peace be upon him) said, "You have accompanied me and treated me well. Who are you?" He replied, "I am the Angel of Death." Idris said, "I have a request for you." He asked, "What is it?" He said, "Take me up to the heaven." The Angel of Death asked his Lord for permission, and He granted it, so he carried him on his wing and ascended with him to the heaven. Then Idris (peace be upon him) said to him, "I have another request for you." He asked, "What is it?" He said, "I have heard that death is severe, and I would like you to let me taste a portion of it so that I may see if it is as I have heard." He asked his Lord for permission, and He granted it. He took his soul for a moment and then released it. He asked him, "How did you find it?" He replied, "I had heard it was severe, but it is even more severe than what I had heard. I have another request for you: show me the Fire." The Angel of Death asked the keeper of the Fire for permission, and he opened it for him. When Idris (peace be upon him) saw it, he fell down unconscious. Then he said to him, "I have another request for you: show me Paradise." The Angel of Death asked the keeper of Paradise for permission, and he entered it. When he looked at it, he said, "O Angel of Death, I will not leave it. For God Almighty says: 'Every soul shall taste death' (3:57), and I have tasted it; and He says: 'There is not one of you but shall pass through it' (19:71), and I have passed through it; and He says regarding Paradise: 'And they shall not be expelled from it' (15:48)."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 94

56.ar: عَنْ إِسْمَاعِیلَ بْنِ مِهْرَانَ قَالَ قَالَ لِیَ الصَّادِقُ (علیه السلام) إِذَا دَخَلْتَ الْکُوفَةَ فَأْتِ مَسْجِدَ السَّهْلَةِ فَصَلِ فِیهِ وَ اسْأَلِ اللَّهَ حَاجَتَکَ لِدِینِکَ وَ دُنْیَاکَ فَإِنَّ مَسْجِدَ السَّهْلَةِ بَیْتُ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) الَّذِی کَانَ یَخِیطُ فِیهِ وَ یُصَلِّی فِیهِ وَ مَنْ دَعَا اللَّهَ فِیهِ بِمَا أَحَبَّ قَضَی لَه حَوَائِجَهُ وَ رَفَعَهُ یَوْمَ الْقِیَامَةِ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا إِلَی دَرَجَةِ إِدْرِیسَ وَ أُجِیرَ مِنْ مَکْرُوهِ الدُّنْیَا وَ مَکَایِدِ أَعْدَائِه.
56.fa: امام صادق (- اسماعیل‌بن‌مهران گوید: امام صادق (به من فرمود: «وقتی‌که به کوفه وارد شدی به مسجد سهله برو و در آنجا نماز بگزار و از خدا حاجتی برای دین و دنیای خود بخواه که همانا مسجد سهله خانه‌ی ادریس (بوده که در آنجا خیّاطی کرده و نماز می‌خوانده و کسی که در آن مکان نماز گزارده و دعا کند، خداوند حاجت او را بر آورده می‌سازد و او را در روز قیامت تا مکانی والا و درجه‌ی ادریس (بالا می‌برد و از امور ناپسند دنیوی و نقشه‌های دشمنانش نیز در پناه خواهد بود».
56.en: Isma'il ibn Mihran narrated: Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) said to me, "When you enter Kufa, go to the Sahla Mosque and pray therein, and ask Allah for your needs regarding your religion and your worldly life. For the Sahla Mosque is the house of Idris (peace be upon him), where he used to sew and pray. Whoever calls upon Allah therein for what he desires, He will fulfill his needs, raise him on the Day of Resurrection to a high place—to the rank of Idris—and he will be protected from the evils of the world and the plots of his enemies."
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 94

56.ar: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ الْبَاقِرِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: کَانَ بَدْءُ نُبُوَّةِ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) أَنَّهُ کَانَ فِی زَمَانِهِ مَلِکٌ جَبَّارٌ وَ أَنَّهُ رَکِبَ ذَاتَ یَوْمٍ فِی بَعْضِ نُزَهِهِ فَمَرَّ بِأَرْضٍ خَضِرَةٍ نَضِرَةٍ لِعَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ مِنَ الرَّافِضَةِ فَأَعْجَبَتْهُ فَسَأَلَ وُزَرَاءَهُ لِمَنْ هَذِهِ الْأَرْضُ قَالُوا لِعَبْدٍ مُؤْمِنٍ مِنْ عَبِیدِ الْمَلِکِ فُلَانٍ الرَّافِضِیِّ فَدَعَا بِهِ فَقَالَ لَهُ أَمْتِعْنِی بِأَرْضِکَ هَذِهِ فَقَالَ عِیَالِی أَحْوَجُ إِلَیْهَا مِنْکَ قَالَ فَسُمْنِی بِهَا أُثْمِنْ لَکَ قَالَ لَا أُمْتِعُکَ بِهَا وَ لَا أَسُومُکَ دَعْ عَنْکَ ذِکْرَهَا فَغَضِبَ الْمَلِکُ عِنْدَ ذَلِکَ وَ أَسِفَ وَ انْصَرَفَ إِلَی أَهْلِهِ وَ هُوَ مَغْمُومٌ مُتَفَکِّرٌ فِی أَمْرِهِ وَ کَانَتْ لَهُ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ الْأَزَارِقَةِ وَ کَانَ بِهَا مُعْجَباً یُشَاوِرُهَا فِی الْأَمْرِ إِذَا نَزَلَ بِهِ فَلَمَّا اسْتَقَرَّ فِی مَجْلِسِهِ بَعَثَ إِلَیْهَا لِیُشَاوِرَهَا فِی أَمْرِ صَاحِبِ الْأَرْضِ فَخَرَجَتْ إِلَیْهِ فَرَأَتْ فِی وَجْهِهِ الْغَضَبَ فَقَالَتْ أَیُّهَا الْمَلِکُ مَا الَّذِی دَهَاکَ حَتَّی بَدَا الْغَضَبُ فِی وَجْهِکَ قَبْلَ فِعْلِکَ فَأَخْبَرَهَا بِخَبَرِ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَا کَانَ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ لِصَاحِبِهَا وَ مِنْ قَوْلِ صَاحِبِهَا لَهُ فَقَالَتْ أَیُّهَا الْمَلِکُ إِنَّمَا یَهْتَمُّ بِهِ مَنْ لَا یَقْدِرُ عَلَی التَّغْیِیرِ وَ الِانْتِقَامِ فَإِنْ کُنْتَ تَکْرَهُ أَنْ تَقْتُلَهُ بِغَیْرِ حُجَّةٍ فَأَنَا أَکْفِیکَ أَمْرَهُ وَ أُصَیِّرُ أَرْضَهُ بِیَدَیْکَ بِحُجَّةٍ لَکَ فِیهَا الْعُذْرُ عِنْدَ أَهْلِ مَمْلَکَتِکَ قَالَ وَ مَا هِیَ قَالَتْ أَبْعَثُ إِلَیْهِ أَقْوَاماً مِنْ أَصْحَابِیَ الْأَزَارِقَةِ حَتَّی یَأْتُوکَ بِهِ فَیَشْهَدُوا عَلَیْهِ عِنْدَکَ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَرِئَ مِنْ دِینِکَ فَیَجُوزَ لَکَ قَتْلُهُ وَ أَخْذُ أَرْضِهِ قَالَ فَافْعَلِی ذَلِکِ قَالَ وَ کَانَ لَهَا أَصْحَابٌ مِنَ الْأَزَارِقَةِ عَلَی دِینِهَا یَرَوْنَ قَتَلَ الرَّوَافِضِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ فَبَعَثَتْ إِلَی قَوْمٍ مِنَ الْأَزَارِقَةِ فَأَتَوْهَا فَأَمَرَتْهُمْ أَنْ یَشْهَدُوا عَلَی فُلَانٍ الرَّافِضِیِّ عِنْدَ الْمَلِکِ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَرِئَ مِنْ دِینِ الْمَلِکِ فَشَهِدُوا عَلَیْهِ أَنَّهُ قَدْ بَرِئَ مِنْ دِینِ الْمَلِکِ فَقَتَلَهُ وَ اسْتَخْلَصَ أَرْضَهُ فَغَضِبَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی لِلْمُؤْمِنِ عِنْدَ ذَلِکَ فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ إِلَی إِدْرِیسَ أَنِ ائْتِ عَبْدِی هَذَا الْجَبَّارَ فَقُلْ لَهُ أَ مَا رَضِیتَ أَنْ قَتَلْتَ عَبْدِیَ الْمُؤْمِنَ ظُلْماً حَتَّی اسْتَخْلَصْتَ أَرْضَهُ خَالِصَةً لَکَ فَأَحْوَجْتَ عِیَالَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَ أَجَعْتَهُمْ أَمَا وَ عِزَّتِی لَأَنْتَقِمَنَّ لَهُ مِنْکَ فِی الْآجِلِ وَ لَأَسْلُبَنَّکَ مُلْکَکَ فِی الْعَاجِلِ وَ لَأُخَرِّبَنَّ مَدِینَتَکَ وَ لَأُذِلَّنَّ عِزَّکَ وَ لَأُطْعِمَنَّ الْکِلَاب لَحْمَ امْرَأَتِکَ فَقَدْ غَرَّکَ یَا مُبْتَلَی حِلْمِی عَنْکَ فَأَتَاهُ إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) بِرِسَالَةِ رَبِّهِ وَ هُوَ فِی مَجْلِسِهِ وَ حَوْلَهُ أَصْحَابُهُ فَقَالَ أَیُّهَا الْجَبَّارُ إِنِّی رَسُولُ اللَّهِ إِلَیْکَ وَ هُوَ یَقُولُ لَکَ أَ مَا رَضِیتَ أَنْ قَتَلْتَ عَبْدِیَ الْمُؤْمِنَ ظُلْماً حَتَّی اسْتَخْلَصْتَ أَرْضَهُ خَالِصَةً لَکَ وَ أَحْوَجْتَ عِیَالَهُ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ وَ أَجَعْتَهُمْ أَمَا وَ عِزَّتِی لَأَنْتَقِمَنَّ لَهُ مِنْکَ فِی الْآجِلِ وَ لَأَسْلُبَنَّکَ مُلْکَکَ فِی الْعَاجِلِ وَ لَأُخَرِّبَنَّ مَدِینَتَکَ وَ لَأُذِلَّنَّ عِزَّکَ وَ لَأُطْعِمَنَّ الْکِلَابَ لَحْمَ امْرَأَتِکَ فَقَالَ الْجَبَّارُ اخْرُجْ عَنِّی یَا إِدْرِیسُ فَلَنْ تَسْبِقَنِی بِنَفْسِکَ ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَ إِلَی امْرَأَتِهِ فَأَخْبَرَهَا بِمَا جَاءَ بِهِ إِدْرِیسُ فَقَالَتْ لَا تَهُولَنَّکَ رِسَالَةُ إِلَهِ إِدْرِیسَ أَنَا أَکْفِیکَ أَمْ-رَ إِدْرِی-سَ أُرْسِلُ إِلَیْهِ مَنْ یَقْتُلُهُ فَتَبْطُلُ رِسَ-الَةُ إِلَهِهِ وَ کُلُّ مَا جَاءَکَ بِهِ قَالَ فَافْعَلِی وَ کَانَ لِإِدْرِیسَ أَصْحَابٌ مِنَ الرَّافِضَةِ مُؤْمِنُونَ یَجْتَمِعُونَ إِلَیْهِ فِی مَجْلِسٍ لَهُ فَیَأْنَسُونَ بِهِ وَ یَأْنَسُ بِهِمْ فَأَخْبَرَهُمْ إِدْرِیسُ بِمَا کَانَ مِنْ وَحْیِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَیْهِ وَ رِسَالَتِهِ إِلَی الْجَبَّارِ وَ مَا کَانَ مِنْ تَبْلِیغِهِ رِسَالَةَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَی الْجَبَّارِ فَأَشْفَقُوا عَلَی إِدْرِیسَ وَ أَصْحَابِهِ وَ خَافُوا عَلَیْهِ الْقَتْلَ وَ بَعَثَتِ امْرَأَةُ الْجَبَّارِ إِلَی إِدْرِیسَ أَرْبَعِینَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَزَارِقَةِ لِیَقْتُلُوهُ فَأَتَوْهُ فِی مَجْلِسِهِ الَّذِی کَانَ یَجْتَمِعُ إِلَیْهِ فِیهِ أَصْحَابُهُ فَلَمْ یَجِدُوهُ فَانْصَرَفُوا وَ قَدْ رَآهُمْ أَصْحَابُ إِدْرِیسَ فَحَسِبُوا أَنَّهُمْ أَتَوْا إِدْرِیسَ لِیَقْتُلُوهُ فَتَفَرَّقُوا فِی طَلَبِهِ فَلَقُوهُ فَقَالُوا لَهُ خُذْ حِذْرَکَ یَا إِدْرِیسُ فَإِنَّ الْجَبَّارَ قَاتِلُکَ قَدْ بَعَثَ الْیَوْمَ أَرْبَعِینَ رَجُلًا مِنَ الْأَزَارِقَةِ لِیَقْتُلُوکَ فَاخْرُجْ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ فَتَنَحَّی إِدْرِیسُ عَنِ الْقَرْیَةِ مِنْ یَوْمِهِ ذَلِکَ وَ مَعَهُ نَفَرٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فَلَمَّا کَانَ فِی السَّحَرِ نَاجَی إِدْرِیسُ رَبَّهُ فَقَالَ یَا رَبِّ بَعَثْتَنِی إِلَی جَبَّارٍ فَبَلَّغْتُ رِسَالَتَکَ وَ قَدْ تَوَعَّدَنِی هَذَا الْجَبَّارُ بِالْقَتْلِ بَلْ هُوَ قَاتِلِی إِنْ ظَفِرَ بِی فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَنْ تَنَحَّ عَنْهُ وَ اخْرُجْ مِنْ قَرْیَتِهِ وَ خَلِّنِی وَ إِیَّاهُ فَوَ عِزَّتِی لَأُنْفِذَنَّ فِیهِ أَمْرِی وَ لَأُصَدِّقَنَّ قَوْلَکَ فِیهِ وَ مَا أَرْسَلْتُکَ بِهِ إِلَیْهِ فَقَالَ إِدْرِیسُ یَا رَبِّ إِنَّ لِی حَاجَةً قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ سَل تُعْطَهَا قَالَ أَسْأَلُکَ أَنْ لَا تُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَی أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ وَ مَا حَوْلَهَا وَ مَا حَوَتْ عَلَیْهِ حَتَّی أَسْأَلَکَ ذَلِکَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ یَا إِدْرِیسُ إِذاً تَخْرُبُ الْقَرْیَةُ وَ یَشْتَدُّ جَهْدُ أَهْلِهَا وَ یَجُوعُونَ قَالَ إِدْرِیسُ وَ إِنْ خَرِبَتْ وَ جَهَدُوا وَ جَاعُوا قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَإِنِّی قَدْ أَعْطَیْتُکَ مَا سَأَلْتَ وَ لَنْ أُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْهِمْ حَتَّی تَسْأَلَنِی ذَلِکَ وَ أَنَا أَحَقُّ مَنْ وَفَی بِوَعْدِهِ فَأَخْبَرَ إِدْرِیسُ أَصْحَابَهُ بِمَا سَأَلَ اللَّهَ مِنْ حَبْسِ الْمَطَرِ عَنْهُمْ وَ بِمَا أَوْحَی اللَّهُ إِلَیْهِ وَ وَعَدَهُ أَنْ لَا یُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْهِمْ حَتَّی یَسْأَلَهُ ذَلِکَ فَاخْرُجُوا أَیُّهَا الْمُؤْمِنُونَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ إِلَی غَیْرِهَا مِنَ الْقُرَی فَخَرَجُوا مِنْهَا وَ عِدَّتُهُمْ یَوْمَئِذٍ عِشْرُونَ رَجُلًا فَتَفَرَّقُوا فِی الْقُرَی وَ شَاعَ خَبَرُ إِدْرِیسَ فِی الْقُرَی بِمَا سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ تَعَالَی وَ تَنَحَّی إِدْرِیسُ إِلَی کَهْفٍ فِی جَبَلٍ شَاهِقٍ فَلَجَأَ إِلَیْهِ وَ وَکَّلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِهِ مَلَکاً یَأْتِیهِ بِطَعَامِهِ عِنْدَ کُلِّ مَسَاءٍ وَ کَانَ یَصُومُ النَّهَارَ فَیَأْتِیهِ الْمَلَکُ بِطَعَامِهِ عِنْدَ کُلِّ مَسَاءٍ وَ سَلَبَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عِنْدَ ذَلِکَ مُلْکَ الْجَبَّارِ وَ قَتَلَهُ وَ أَخْرَبَ مَدِینَتَهُ وَ أَطْعَمَ الْکِلَابَ لَحْمَ امْرَأَتِهِ غَضَباً لِلْمُؤْمِنِ فَظَهَرَ فِی الْمَدِینَةِ جَبَّارٌ آخَرُ عَاصٍ فَمَکَثُوا بِذَلِکَ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ إِدْرِیسَ مِنَ الْقَرْیَةِ عِشْرِینَ سَنَةً لَمْ تُمْطِرِ السَّمَاءُ عَلَیْهِمْ قَطْرَةً مِنْ مَائِهَا عَلَیْهِمْ فَجَهَدَ الْقَوْمُ وَ اشْتَدَّتْ حَالُهُمْ وَ صَارُوا یَمْتَارُونَ الْأَطْعِمَةَ مِنَ الْقُرَی مِنْ بُعْدٍ فَلَمَّا جَهَدُوا مَشَی بَعْضُهُمْ إِلَی بَعْضٍ فَقَالُوا إِنَّ الَّذِی نَزَلَ بِنَا مِمَّا تَرَوْنَ بِسُؤَالِ إِدْرِیسَ رَبَّهُ أَنْ لَا یُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْنَا حَتَّی یَسْأَلَهُ هُوَ وَ قَدْ خَفِیَ إِدْرِیسُ عَنَّا وَ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا بِمَوْضِعِهِ وَ اللَّهُ أَرْحَمُ بِنَا مِنْهُ فَأَجْمَعَ أَمْرُهُمْ عَلَی أَنْ یَتُوبُوا إِلَی اللَّهِ وَ یَدْعُوهُ وَ یَفْزَعُوا إِلَیْهِ وَ یَسْأَلُوهُ أَنْ یُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ عَلَی مَا حَوَتْ قَرْیَتُهُمْ فَقَامُوا عَلَی الرَّمَادِ وَ لَبِسُوا الْمُسُوحَ وَ حَثَوْا عَلَی رُءُوسِهِمُ التُّرَابَ وَ عَجُّوا إِلَی اللَّهِ تَعَالَی بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ وَ الْبُکَاءِ وَ التَّضَرُّعِ إِلَیْهِ فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ حَلَّ إِلَی إِدْرِیسَ یَا إِدْرِیسُ إِنَّ أَهْلَ قَرْیَتِکَ قَدْ عَجُّوا إِلَیَّ بِالتَّوْبَةِ وَ الِاسْتِغْفَارِ وَ الْبُکَاءِ وَ التَّضَرُّعِ وَ أَنَا اللَّهُ الرَّحْمَنُ الرَّحِیمُ أَقْبَلُ التَّوْبَةَ وَ أَعْفُو عَنِ السَّیِّئَةِ وَ قَدْ رَحِمْتُهُمْ وَ لَمْ یَمْنَعْنِی إِجَابَتَهُمْ إِلَی مَا سَأَلُونِی مِنَ الْمَطَرِ إِلَّا مُنَاظَرَتُکَ فِیمَا سَأَلْتَنِی أَنْ لَا أُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْهِمْ حَتَّی تَسْأَلَنِی فَسَلْنِی یَا إِدْرِیسُ حَتَّی أُغِیثَهُمْ وَ أُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْهِمْ قَالَ إِدْرِیسُ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّی لَا أَسْأَلُکَ ذَلِکَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أَ لَمْ تَسْأَلْنِی یَا إِدْرِیسُ فَأَجَبْتُکَ إِلَی مَا سَأَلْتَ وَ أَنَا أَسْأَلُکَ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِی فَلِمَ لَا تجب {تُجِیبُ} مَسْأَلَتِی قَالَ إِدْرِیسُ اللَّهُمَّ لَا أَسْأَلُکَ فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَی الْمَلَکِ الَّذِی أَمَرَهُ أَنْ یَأْتِیَ إِدْرِیسَ بِطَعَامِهِ کُلَّ مَسَاءٍ أَنِ احْبِسْ عَنْ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) طَعَامَهُ وَ لَا تَأْتِهِ بِهِ فَلَمَّا أَمْسَی إِدْرِیسُ فِی لَیْلَةِ ذَلِکَ الْیَوْمِ فَلَمْ یُؤْتَ بِطَعَامِهِ حَزِنَ وَ جَاعَ فَصَبَرَ فَلَمَّا کَانَ فِی لَیْلَةِ الْیَوْمِ الثَّانِی فَلَمْ یُؤْتَ بِطَعَامِهِ اشْتَدَّ حُزْنُهُ وَ جُوعُهُ فَلَمَّا کَانَتِ اللَّیْلَةُ مِنَ الْیَوْمِ الثَّالِثِ فَلَمْ یُؤْتَ بِطَعَامِهِ اشْتَدَّ جُهْدُهُ وَ جُوعُهُ وَ حُزْنُهُ وَ قَلَّ صَبْرُهُ فَنَادَی رَبَّهُ یَا رَبِّ حَبَسْتَ عَنِّی رِزْقِی مِنْ قَبْلِ أَنْ تَقْبِضَ رُوحِی فَأَوْحَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَیْهِ یَا إِدْرِیسُ جَزِعْتَ أَنْ حَبَسْتُ عَنْکَ طَعَامَکَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَیَّامٍ وَ لَیَالِیَهَا وَ لَمْ تَجْزَعْ وَ لَمْ تَذْکُرْ جُوعَ أَهْلِ قَرْیَتِکَ وَ جُهْدَهُمْ مُنْذُ عِشْرِینَ سَنَةً ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُکَ عَنْ جُهْدِهِمْ وَ رَحْمَتِی إِیَّاهُمْ أَنْ تَسْأَلَنِی أَنْ أُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْهِمْ فَلَمْ تَسْأَلْنِی وَ بَخِلْتَ عَلَیْهِمْ بِمَسْأَلَتِکَ إِیَّایَ فَأَدَّبْتُکَ بِالْجُوعِ فَقَلَّ عِنْدَ ذَلِکَ صَبْرُکَ وَ ظَهَرَ جَزَعُکَ فَاهْبِطْ مِنْ مَوْضِعِکَ فَاطْلُبِ الْمَعَاشَ لِنَفْسِکَ فَقَدْ وَکَلْتُکَ فِی طَلَبِهِ إِلَی حِیلَتِکَ فَهَبَطَ إِدْرِیسُ مِنْ مَوْضِعِهِ إِلَی قَرْیَةٍ یَطْلُبُ أُکْلَةً مِنْ جُوعٍ فَلَمَّا دَخَلَ الْقَرْیَةَ نَظَرَ إِلَی دُخَانٍ فِی بَعْضِ مَنَازِلِهَا فَأَقْبَلَ نَحْوَهُ فَهَجَمَ عَلَی عَجُوزٍ کَبِیرَةٍ وَ هِیَ تُرَقِّقُ قُرْصَتَیْنِ لَهَا عَلَی مِقْلَاةٍ فَقَالَ لَهَا أَیَّتُهَا الْمَرْأَةُ أَطْعِمِینِی فَإِنِّی مَجْهُودٌ مِنَ الْجُوعِ فَقَالَتْ لَهُ یَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ مَا تَرَکَتْ لَنَا دَعْوَةُ إِدْرِیسَ فَضْلًا نُطْعِمُهُ أَحَداً وَ حَلَفَتْ أَنَّهَا مَا تَمْلِکُ غَیْرَهُ شَیْئاً فَاطْلُبِ الْمَعَاشَ مِنْ غَیْرِ أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الْقَرْیَةِ فَقَالَ لَهَا أَطْعِمِینِی مَا أُمْسِکُ بِهِ رُوحِی وَ تَحْمِلُنِی بِهِ رِجْلِی إِلَی أَنْ أَطْلُبَ قَالَتْ إِنَّمَا هُمَا قُرْصَتَانِ وَاحِدَةٌ لِی وَ الْأُخْرَی لِابْنِی فَإِنْ أَطْعَمْتُکَ قُوتِی مِتُّ وَ إِنْ أَطْعَمْتُکَ قُوتَ ابْنِی مَاتَ وَ مَا هَاهُنَا فَضْلٌ أُطْعِمُکَهُ فَقَالَ لَهَا إِن ابْنَکَ صَغِیرٌ یُجْزِیهِ نِصْفُ قُرْصَةٍ فَیَحْیَا بِهِ وَ یُجْزِینِی النِّصْفُ الْآخَرُ فَأَحْیَا بِهِ وَ فِی ذَلِکِ بُلْغَةٌ لِی وَ لَهُ فَأَکَلَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ قُرْصَتَهَا وَ کَسَرَتِ الْأُخْرَی بَیْنَ إِدْرِیسَ وَ بَیْنَ ابْنِهَا فَلَمَّا رَأَی ابْنُهَا إِدْرِیسَ یَأْکُلُ مِنْ قُرْصَتِهِ اضْطَرَبَ حَتَّی مَاتَ قَالَتْ أُمُّهُ یَا عَبْدَ اللَّهِ قَتَلْتَ عَلَیَّ ابْنِی جَزَعاً عَلَی قُوتِهِ قَالَ لَهَا إِدْرِی-سُ فَأَنَا أُحْیِیهِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی فَلَا تَجْزَعِی ثُمَّ أَخَذَ إِدْرِیسُ بِعَضُدَیِ الصَّبِیِّ ثُمَّ قَالَ أَیَّتُهَا الرُّوحُ الْخَارِجَةُ عَنْ بَدَنِ هَذَا الْغُلَامِ بِأَمْرِ اللَّهِ ارْجِعِی إِلَی بَدَنِهِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ وَ أَنَا إِدْرِیسُ النَّبِیُّ فَرَجَعَتْ رُوحُ الْغُلَامِ إِلَیْهِ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ فَلَمَّا سَمِعَتِ الْمَرْأَةُ کَلَامَ إِدْرِیسَ وَ قَوْلَهُ أَنَا إِدْرِیسُ وَ نَظَرَتْ عَلَی ابْنِهَا قَدْ عَاشَ بَعْدَ الْمَوْتِ قَالَتْ أَشْهَدُ أَنَّکَ إِدْرِیسُ النَّبِیُّ وَ خَرَجَتْ تُنَادِی بِأَعْلَی صَوْتِهَا فِی الْقَرْیَةِ أَبْشِرُوا بِالْفَرَجِ فَقَدْ دَخَلَ إِدْرِیسُ قَرْیَتَکُمْ وَ مَضَی إِدْرِیسُ حَتَّی جَلَسَ عَلَی مَوْضِعِ مَدِینَةِ الْجَبَّارِ الْأَوَّلِ فَوَجَدَهَا وَ هِیَ تَلٌّ فَاجْتَمَعَ إِلَیْهِ أُنَاسٌ مِنْ أَهْلِ قَرْیَتِهِ فَقَالُوا لَهُ یَا إِدْرِیسُ أَ مَا رَحِمْتَنَا فِی هَذِهِ الْعِشْرِینَ سَنَةً الَّتِی جُهِدْنَا فِیهَا وَ مَسَّنَا الْجُوعُ وَ الْجُهْدُ فِیهَا فَادْعُ اللَّهَ لَنَا أَنْ یُمْطِرَ السَّمَاءَ عَلَیْنَا قَالَ لَا حَتَّی یَأْتِیَنِی جَبَّارُکُمْ هَذَا وَ جَمِیعُ أَهْلِ قَرْیَتِکُمْ مُشَاةً حُفَاةً فَیَسْأَلُونِی ذَلِکَ فَبَلَغَ الْجَبَّارَ قَوْلُهُ فَبَعَثَ إِلَیْهِ أَرْبَعِینَ رَجُلًا یَأْتُوهُ بِإِدْرِیسَ فَأَتَوْهُ فَقَالُوا لَهُ إِنَّ الْجَبَّارَ بَعَثَنَا إِلَیْکَ لِنَذْهَبَ بِکَ إِلَیْهِ فَدَعَا عَلَیْهِمْ فَمَاتُوا فَبَلَغَ الْجَبَّارَ ذَلِکَ فَبَعَثَ إِلَیْهِ مبتلا کرده‌ای و اکنون نفرین می‌کنی تا ما هلاک شویم، به ما رحم کن». ادریس (مجدّدا تکرار کرد، من برای بارش باران دعا نمی‌کنم، مگر اینکه پادشاه شما و همه مردم با پسر و پای برهنه به نزد من بیایند، آنگاه مردم به نزد پادشاه رفتند و او را از گفتار ادریس (باخبر کردند و از او خواستند که همراه ایشان به نزد ادریس (روانه شود، آن جبّار هم مجبور به اطاعت شد و همگی باحالت خضوع و خشوع به نزد ادریس (رفته و از او درخواست کردند که برای بارش باران دعا کند، آن وقت ادریس (به آنان جواب مثبت داد و به درگاه الهی دعا کرد که آسمان بر آن شهر و اطراف آن ببارد، ناگهان ابرها نمودار شد و رعد و برق در گرفت و آنقدر باران بارید که پنداشتند غرق خواهند شد و هر یک درحالی به خانه خود بازمی‌گشتند که مهم‌ترین مقصدشان نجات از سیل بود.
56.en:
From Abu Ja’far Muhammad ibn Ali al-Baqir (peace be upon him), who said: The beginning of the prophethood of Idris (peace be upon him) was that there was a tyrannical king in his time. One day, while riding through some of his pleasure grounds, he passed by a lush, green land belonging to a believing servant from the Rafida. It pleased him, so he asked his ministers, "To whom does this land belong?" They replied, "To a believing servant from among the servants of the king, a certain Rafidi." He summoned him and said, "Let me enjoy this land of yours." The man replied, "My family is more in need of it than you." The king said, "Then sell it to me; I will pay you for it." The man said, "I will not let you enjoy it, nor will I sell it to you. Leave off mentioning it." The king became angry at this, felt resentful, and returned to his family, distressed and deep in thought about the matter. He had a wife from the Azariqa sect, and he was fond of her and would consult her whenever a matter befell him. When he settled in his assembly, he sent for her to consult her regarding the owner of the land. She came to him and saw the anger on his face, so she said, "O King, what has afflicted you that anger appears on your face before you have acted?" He told her the story of the land and what had passed between him and its owner. She said, "O King, only one who is unable to change things or take revenge worries about this. If you dislike killing him without a pretext, I will suffice you in this matter and place his land in your hands with a pretext that will provide you with an excuse before the people of your kingdom." He asked, "And what is that?" She said, "I will send some men from my companions, the Azariqa, to bring him to you, and they will testify before you that he has renounced your religion, so it will be lawful for you to kill him and take his land." He said, "Then do so." She had companions from the Azariqa who followed her faith and considered the killing of the Rafida believers to be lawful. She sent for a group of them, and they came to her. She ordered them to testify before the king against that Rafidi man that he had renounced the king’s religion. They testified against him that he had renounced the king’s religion, so the king killed him and seized his land.

God Almighty became angry for the sake of the believer at that, and God revealed to Idris: "Go to this tyrannical servant of Mine and say to him: 'Are you not satisfied that you killed My believing servant unjustly, until you seized his land for yourself, leaving his family in need after him and causing them to go hungry? By My Might, I will surely take revenge on him from you in the Hereafter, and I will surely strip you of your kingdom in this world, and I will surely destroy your city, and I will surely humiliate your glory, and I will surely feed the dogs the flesh of your wife. You have been deceived, O afflicted one, by My forbearance toward you.'"

Idris (peace be upon him) came to him with the message of his Lord while he was in his assembly, surrounded by his companions. He said, "O tyrant, I am the messenger of God to you, and He says to you: 'Are you not satisfied that you killed My believing servant unjustly, until you seized his land for yourself, leaving his family in need after him and causing them to go hungry? By My Might, I will surely take revenge on him from you in the Hereafter, and I will surely strip you of your kingdom in this world, and I will surely destroy your city, and I will surely humiliate your glory, and I will surely feed the dogs the flesh of your wife.'" The tyrant said, "Get out from my presence, O Idris, for you shall not escape me with your life." Then he sent for his wife and told her what Idris had brought. She said, "Do not let the message of Idris’s god frighten you. I will suffice you in the matter of Idris; I will send someone to kill him, and the message of his god and everything he brought will be nullified." He said, "Then do so."

Idris had companions from the Rafida, believers who would gather with him in a place of his, finding comfort in him, and he in them. Idris informed them of what God Almighty had revealed to him, his message to the tyrant, and his delivery of God’s message to the tyrant. They felt pity for Idris and his companions and feared for him that he would be killed. The tyrant’s wife sent forty men from the Azariqa to kill Idris. They came to him in the place where his companions used to gather, but they did not find him, so they left. Idris’s companions had seen them and thought they had come to kill Idris, so they scattered in search of him. They met him and said, "Take caution, O Idris, for the tyrant is going to kill you. He sent forty men from the Azariqa today to kill you. Leave this village." Idris moved away from the village that very day, with a group of his companions.

At dawn, Idris prayed to his Lord, saying, "O Lord, You sent me to a tyrant, and I delivered Your message, and this tyrant has threatened me with death; indeed, he will kill me if he catches me." God Almighty revealed to him: "Move away from him, leave his village, and leave him to Me. By My Might, I will surely execute My command upon him and verify your word regarding him and what I sent you with to him." Idris said, "O Lord, I have a request." God Almighty said, "Ask, and it shall be granted to you." He said, "I ask You not to let the sky rain upon the people of this village, nor its surroundings, nor what it contains, until I ask You for that." God Almighty said, "O Idris, then the village will be ruined, and its people will suffer greatly and go hungry." Idris said, "Even if it is ruined, and they suffer, and they go hungry." God Almighty said, "Then I have granted you what you asked, and I will never let the sky rain upon them until you ask Me for that, and I am the most worthy to fulfill My promise."

Idris informed his companions of what he had asked of God regarding the withholding of rain from them, and what God had revealed to him and promised him—that He would not let the sky rain upon them until he asked Him. "So leave this village, O believers, for other villages." They left it, and their number that day was twenty men. They scattered among the villages, and the news of Idris spread among the villages regarding what he had asked of his Lord. Idris moved to a cave in a towering mountain and took refuge there. God Almighty appointed an angel to bring him his food every evening, and he would fast during the day.

God Almighty then stripped the tyrant of his kingdom, killed him, destroyed his city, and fed the dogs the flesh of his wife, in anger for the believer. Another rebellious tyrant appeared in the city. They remained like that for twenty years after Idris left the village, and the sky did not rain a single drop of water upon them. The people suffered, their condition became severe, and they began to import food from distant villages. When they suffered, they went to one another and said, "What has befallen us, as you see, is because of Idris asking his Lord not to let the sky rain upon us until he asks Him. Idris has hidden from us, and we have no knowledge of his whereabouts, and God is more merciful to us than he is." They agreed to repent to God, call upon Him, turn to Him, and ask Him to let the sky rain upon them and upon what their village contained. They stood on ashes, wore coarse garments, threw dust upon their heads, and cried out to God Almighty with repentance, seeking forgiveness, weeping, and beseeching Him.

God Almighty revealed to Idris: "O Idris, the people of your village have cried out to Me with repentance, seeking forgiveness, weeping, and beseeching Me, and I am God, the Compassionate, the Merciful. I accept repentance and pardon sins. I have had mercy on them, and nothing has prevented Me from answering their request for rain except your challenge in what you asked Me—that I should not let the sky rain upon them until you ask Me. So ask Me, O Idris, so that I may grant them relief and let the sky rain upon them." Idris said, "O God, I will not ask You for that." God Almighty said, "Did you not ask Me, O Idris, and I answered your request? And I am asking you to ask Me, so why do you not answer My request?" Idris said, "O God, I will not ask You."

God Almighty revealed to the angel whom He had commanded to bring Idris his food every evening: "Withhold Idris’s food from him and do not bring it to him." When evening came for Idris that night and he was not brought his food, he became sad and hungry, but he remained patient. When the night of the second day came and he was not brought his food, his sadness and hunger intensified. When the night of the third day came and he was not brought his food, his suffering, hunger, and sadness became severe, and his patience diminished. He called out to his Lord, "O Lord, You have withheld my provision from me before taking my soul!" God Almighty revealed to him: "O Idris, you have become impatient because I withheld your food for three days and nights, yet you did not become impatient, nor did you mention the hunger of the people of your village and their suffering for twenty years. Then I asked you about their suffering and My mercy toward them, that you should ask Me to let the sky rain upon them, but you did not ask Me, and you were stingy toward them with your request to Me. So I disciplined you with hunger, and your patience diminished, and your impatience became apparent. So descend from your place and seek a livelihood for yourself, for I have left you to your own devices in seeking it."

Idris descended from his place to a village, seeking a morsel of food due to hunger. When he entered the village, he saw smoke in one of the houses, so he headed toward it. He came upon an old woman who was thinning two loaves of bread for herself on a griddle. He said to her, "O woman, feed me, for I am exhausted from hunger." She said to him, "O servant of God, the curse of Idris has left us no surplus to feed anyone," and she swore that she possessed nothing else. "So seek a livelihood from someone other than the people of this village." He said to her, "Feed me something to sustain my soul and help my legs carry me until I can seek it." She said, "There are only two loaves, one for me and the other for my son. If I feed you my sustenance, I will die, and if I feed you my son’s sustenance, he will die, and there is no surplus here to feed you." He said to her, "Your son is small; half a loaf is enough for him, and he will live by it, and the other half is enough for me, and I will live by it, and in that is enough for me and for him." The woman ate her loaf and broke the other between Idris and her son. When her son saw Idris eating from his loaf, he became agitated until he died. His mother said to him, "O servant of God, you have killed my son out of distress for his food!" Idris said to her, "I will revive him by the permission of God Almighty, so do not be distressed." Then Idris took the boy by his arms and said, "O soul that has departed from the body of this boy by the command of God, return to his body by the permission of God, for I am Idris the Prophet." The boy’s soul returned to him by the permission of God. When the woman heard Idris’s words and his saying, "I am Idris," and saw her son alive after death, she said, "I bear witness that you are Idris the Prophet." She went out, calling at the top of her voice in the village, "Rejoice in relief, for Idris has entered your village!"

Idris went until he sat at the site of the first tyrant’s city, and he found it to be a mound. People from his village gathered around him and said, "O Idris, have you not had mercy on us during these twenty years in which we have suffered, and hunger and hardship have touched us? Pray to God for us to let the sky rain upon us." He said, "No, not until your tyrant here and all the people of your village come to me on foot, barefoot, and ask me for that." The tyrant heard his words, so he sent forty men to bring Idris to him. They came to him and said, "The tyrant has sent us to you to take you to him." He prayed against them, and they died. The tyrant heard of this, so he sent five hundred men to bring him. They came to him and said, "O Idris (peace be upon him), the tyrant has sent us to you to take you to him." Idris said to them, "Look at the burial places of your companions." They said to him, "O Idris, you have killed us with hunger for twenty years, and now you want to pray for our death? Do you have no mercy?" He said, "I am not going to him, and I am not going to ask God to let the sky rain upon you until your tyrant comes to me walking, barefoot, and the people of your village." They went to the tyrant and informed him of Idris’s words and asked him to go with them, and all the people of their village, to Idris on foot and barefoot. They came to him and stood before him, submissive to him, asking him to pray to God Almighty to let the sky rain upon them. Idris said to them, "As for now, yes." Idris then prayed to God Almighty to let the sky rain upon them, their village, and its surroundings. A cloud from the sky overshadowed them, and it thundered and flashed, and it rained upon them from that very hour until they thought they would drown. They did not return to their homes until they were concerned for their own lives because of the water.
56.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 96
56.refs: Kamal al-Din, Vol. 1, p. 127 / Nur al-Thaqalayn

57.ar: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَخْبَرَنِی جَبْرَئِیلُ أَنَّ مَلَکاً مِنْ مَلَائِکَةِ اللَّهِ کَانَتْ لَهُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ عزّوجلّ مَنْزِلَةٌ عَظِیمَةٌ فَتُعُتِّبَ عَلَیْهِ فَأُهْبِطَ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ إِلَی الْأَرْضِ فَأَتَی إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) فَقَالَ إِنَّ لَکَ مِنَ اللَّهِ مَنْزِلَةً فَاشْفَعْ لِی عِنْدَ رَبِّکَ فَصَلَّی ثَلَاثَ لَیَالٍ لَا یَفْتُرُ وَ صَامَ أَیَّامَهَا لَا یُفْطِرُ ثُمَّ طَلَبَ إِلَی اللَّهِ تَعَالَی فِی السَّحَرِ فِی الْمَلَ-کِ فَقَالَ الْمَلَکُ إِنَّکَ قَدْ أُعْطِیتَ سُؤْلَکَ وَ قَدْ أُطْلِقَ لِی جَ-نَاحِی وَ أَنَا أُحِبُّ أَنْ أُکَافِیَکَ فَاطْلُبْ إِلَیَّ حَاجَةً فَقَالَ تُرِینِی مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ لَعَلِّی آنَسُ بِهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَیْسَ یَهْنِئُنِی مَعَ ذِکْرِهِ شَیْءٌ فَبَسَطَ جَنَاحَهُ ثُمَّ قَالَ ارْکَبْ فَصَعِدَ بِهِ یَطْلُبُ مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ فِی السَّمَاءِ الدُّنْیَا فَقِیلَ لَهُ اصْعَدْ فَاسْتَقْبَلَهُ بَیْنَ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ الْخَامِسَةِ فَقَالَ الْمَلَکُ یَا مَلَکَ الْمَوْتِ مَا لِی أَرَاکَ قَاطِباً قَالَ الْعَجَبُ إِنِّی تَحْتَ ظِلِّ الْعَرْشِ حَیْثُ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَقْبِضَ رُوحَ آدَمِیٍّ بَیْنَ السَّمَاءِ الرَّابِعَةِ وَ الْخَامِسَةِ فَسَمِعَ إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) فَامْتَعَضَ فَخَرَّ مِنْ جَنَاحِ الْمَلَکِ فَقُبِضَ رُوحُهُ مَکَانَهُ وَ قَالَ اللَّهُ عزّوجلّ وَ رَفَعْناهُ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا.
57.fa: پیامبر (- رسول خدا (فرمود: جبرئیل به من خبر داده است که فرشته‌ای از فرشتگان آسمان که در نزد خداوند از جایگاه عظیمی برخوردار بود، مورد خشم خداوند قرارگرفت، و از آسمان به زمین فرو فرستاده شد. پس نزد ادریس (آمد و گفت: «تو در نزد خداوند از منزلت والایی برخورداری، نزد خداوند، مرا شفاعت کن». او نیز سه شب پشت سر هم نماز گزارد و روزهایش را نیز بی آنکه افطار کند، روزه گرفت. سپس درهنگام سحر برای آن فرشته به درگاه خداوند عزّوجلّ دعا کرد. فرشته گفت: «درخواست تو اجاب-ت شد و من نیز آزاد شدم. اکنون می‌خ-واهم تو را پاداش ده-م. حال چ-یزی از من طلب کن». ادریس (گفت: «می‌توانی فرشته‌ی مرگ را به من نشان دهی، شاید که با او انس بگیرم، زیرا با یادآوری نام او، هیچ‌چیز برایم خوشایند نمی‌گردد». او بال‌هایش را گشود و گفت: «سوار شو». آنگاه ادریس (را در آسمان دنیا بالا برد و در جستجوی فرشته‌ی مرگ برآمد. به او گفتند: «باید بالاتر بروی». او رفت تا اینکه فرشته‌ی مرگ را بین آسمان چهارم و پنجم ملاقات کرد. آن فرشته صدا زد: «ای فرشته‌ی مرگ! چرا تو را اندوهگین و چهره درهم کشیده می‌بینم»؟ او گفت: «شگفتی‌ام از آن است که در زیر سایه‌ی عرش دستور گرفتم که روح یک آدمیزاد را بین آسمان چهارم و پنجم قبض کنم. ادریس (با شنیدن این جمله، حالش تغییر کرد و بر روی بال فرشته بیهوش شد و فرشته‌ی مرگ درهمان لحظه، روحش را قبض نمود. خداوند عزّوجلّ در مورد او فرموده است: وَ رَفَعْنَاهُ مَکَانًا عَلِیًّا».
57.en: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Gabriel informed me that an angel among the angels of Allah, who held a great status before Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He), was rebuked and cast down from the heaven to the earth. He came to Idris (peace be upon him) and said, 'You have a status before Allah; intercede for me with your Lord.' Idris prayed for three nights without ceasing and fasted during their days without breaking his fast. Then, at dawn, he petitioned Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) regarding the angel. The angel said, 'Your request has been granted, and my wings have been restored. I wish to reward you, so ask of me a need.' Idris said, 'Show me the Angel of Death, perhaps I may find comfort in him, for nothing is pleasant to me when I remember him.' The angel spread his wings and said, 'Mount.' He ascended with him, seeking the Angel of Death in the lowest heaven. It was said to him, 'Ascend further.' He met him between the fourth and fifth heavens. The angel said, 'O Angel of Death, why do I see you frowning?' He replied, 'It is a wonder! I was under the shadow of the Throne when I was commanded to take the soul of a human being between the fourth and fifth heavens.' Idris (peace be upon him) heard this, became distressed, and fell from the angel's wing, and his soul was taken at that very spot. And Allah (Mighty and Majestic is He) said: 'And We raised him to a high station.'"
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 102
57.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 3, p. 257; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Rawandi, Vol. 1, p. 76; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan; "Fakhara" (he fell) instead of "Fakhra" (he was distressed).

57.ar: وَ رَفَعْناهُ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا أَیْ عَالِیاً رَفِیعاً وَ قِیلَ: إِنَّهُ رُفِعَ إِلَی السَّمَاءِ السَّادِسَةِ.
57.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- مَکاناً عَلِیًّا یعنی موقعیّتی بلند مرتبه که همان رسالت الهی است و بعضی هم گفته‌اند خداوند او را تا آسمان ششم بالا برده است.
57.en: "And We raised him to a high station," meaning a lofty, exalted position. It has also been said that he was raised to the sixth heaven.
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 104
57.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 11, p. 270; Qisas al-Anbiya by al-Jaza'iri, p. 60; [with slight variations]

57.ar: قَوْلُهُ عزّوجلّ ثُمَّ قَسَتْ قُلُوبُکُمْ مِنْ بَعْدِ ذلِکَ فَهِیَ کَالْحِجارَةِ أَوْ أَشَدُّ قَسْوَة قَالَ الْإِمَامُ (علیه السلام) هَذَا التَّقْرِیعُ مِنَ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی لِلْیَهُودِ وَ النَّاصِبِ وَ الْیَهُودُ جَمَعُوا الْأَمْرَیْنِ وَ اقْتَرَفُوا الْخَطِیئَتَیْنِ فَغَلُظَ عَلَی الْیَهُودِ مَا وَبَّخَهُمْ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَقَالَ جَمَاعَةٌ مِنْ رُؤَسَائِهِمْ وَ ذَوِی الْأَلْسُنِ وَ الْبَیَانِ مِنْهُمْ یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) زَعَمْتَ أَنَّهُ مَا فِی قُلُوبِنَا شَیْءٌ مِنْ مُوَاسَاةِ الْفُقَرَاءِ وَ مُعَاوَنَةِ الضُّعَفَاءِ وَ النَّفَقَةِ فِی إِبْطَالِ الْبَاطِلِ وَ إِحْقَاقِ الْحَقِّ وَ أَنَّ الْأَحْجَارَ أَلْیَنُ مِنْ قُلُوبِنَا وَ أَطْوَعُ لِلَّهِ مِنَّا وَ هَذِهِ الْجِبَالُ بِحَضْرَتِنَا فَهَلُمَّ بِنَا إِلَی بَعْضِهَا فَاسْتَشْهِدْهُ عَلَی تَصْدِیقِکَ وَ تَکْذِیبِنَا فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) نَعَمْ فَخَرَجُوا إِلَی أَوْعَرِ جَبَلٍ رَأَوْهُ فَقَالُوا یَا مُحَمَّدُ هَذَا الْجَبَلُ فَاسْتَشْهِدْهُ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لِلْجَبَلِ إِنِّی أَسْأَلُکَ بِجَاهِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ آلِهِ الطَّیِّبِینَ الَّذِینَ بِذِکْرِ أَسْمَائِهِمْ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ الْعَرْشَ عَلَی کَوَاهِلِ ثَمَانِیَةٍ مِنَ الْمَلَائِکَةِ بَعْدَ أَنْ لَمْ یَقْدِرُوا عَلَی تَحْرِیکِهِ وَ هُمْ خَلْقٌ کَثِیرٌ لَا یَعْرِفُ عَدَدَهُمْ إِلَّا اللَّهُ عزّوجلّ وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ آلِهِ الطَّیِّبِینَ الَّذِینَ بِذِکْرِ أَسْمَائِهِمْ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَی آدَمَ وَ غَفَرَ خَطِیئَتَهُ وَ أَعَادَهُ إِلَی مَرْتَبَتِهِ وَ بِحَقِّ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ آلِهِ الطَّیِّبِینَ الَّذِینَ بِذِکْرِ أَسْمَائِهِمْ وَ سُؤَالِ اللَّهِ بِهِمْ رُفِعَ إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) فِی الْجَنَّةِ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا لَمَّا شَهِدْتَ لِمُحَمَّدٍ بِمَا أَوْدَعَکَ اللَّهُ بِتَصْدِیقِهِ عَلَی هَؤُلَاءِ الْیَهُودِ فِی ذِکْرِ قَسَاوَةِ قُلُوبِهِمْ وَ تَکْذِیبِهِمْ فِی جَحْدِهِمْ لِقَوْلِ مُحَمَّدٍ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَتَحَرَّکَ الْجَبَلُ وَ تَزَلْزَلَ وَ فَاضَ عَنْهُ الْمَاءُ وَ نَادَی یَا مُحَمَّدُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَشْهَدُ أَنَّکَ رَسُولُ (صلی الله علیه و آله) رَبِّ الْعَالَمِینَ.
57.en: Regarding His saying, the Almighty and Exalted: "Then your hearts hardened after that, being like stones or even harder." The Imam (peace be upon him) said: This is a rebuke from Allah, the Exalted, to the Jews and the Nasibis. The Jews combined both matters and committed both sins. The reproach that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) directed at them weighed heavily upon the Jews. A group of their leaders and those among them who were eloquent and articulate said: "O Muhammad! You claim that there is nothing in our hearts regarding the consolation of the poor, the assistance of the weak, the spending of wealth to invalidate falsehood and establish the truth, and that stones are softer than our hearts and more obedient to Allah than us. These mountains are before us, so come with us to one of them and seek its testimony to confirm you and belie us." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "Yes." They went out to the most rugged mountain they could see and said: "O Muhammad, this is the mountain, so seek its testimony." The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said to the mountain: "I ask you by the status of Muhammad and his pure family, by the mention of whose names Allah lightened the Throne upon the shoulders of eight of the angels after they were unable to move it, even though they are a vast creation whose number is known only to Allah, the Almighty and Exalted; and by the right of Muhammad and his pure family, by the mention of whose names Allah accepted the repentance of Adam, forgave his sin, and restored him to his rank; and by the right of Muhammad and his pure family, by the mention of whose names and the asking of Allah through them, Idris (peace be upon him) was raised to a high place in Paradise—that you bear witness for Muhammad regarding what Allah has entrusted to you, confirming him against these Jews regarding the hardness of their hearts and their denial in rejecting the words of Muhammad, the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family)." The mountain moved, trembled, water gushed forth from it, and it cried out: "O Muhammad, I bear witness that you are the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds."
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 104

57.ar: فِی کِتَابِ عِلَلُ الشَّرَائِعِ بِإِسْنَادِهِ إِلَی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ یَزِیدَ بْنِ سَلَّامٍ أَنَّهُ قَالَ لِرَسُولِ اللهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ قَدْ سَأَلَهُ عَنِ الْأَیَّامِ. فَالْخَمِیسُ قَالَ هُوَ یَوْمٌ خَامِسٌ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا وَ هُوَ یَوْمٌ أَنِیسٌ لُعِنَ فِیهِ إِبْلِیسُ وَ رُفِعَ فِیهِ إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) الْحَدِیثَ.
57.fa: پیامبر (- عبدالله‌بن‌یزیدبن‌سلام از پیامبر (درباره‌ی روز پنج شنبه پرسید. پیغمبر (فرمود: «پنجشنبه روز پنجم دنیا است روز انیس است که در آن ابلیس لعن شده و ادریس (بالا برده شده است».
57.en: In the book 'Ilal al-Sharai', with his chain of narration reaching Abdullah ibn Yazid ibn Salam, it is narrated that he asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) about the days. Regarding Thursday, he said: "It is the fifth day of the world and it is a day of companionship (anis), in which Iblis was cursed and Idris (peace be upon him) was raised up." [End of hadith].
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 106

57.ar: نَعَمْ یَا ابْنَ سَلَام.. وَ أَمَّا التِّسْعَةُ وَ الْعِشْرُونَ رَفَعَ اللَّهُ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام) مَکاناً عَلِیًّا.
57.fa: پیامبر (- [پیامبر (در مورد برخی اعداد خطاب به ابن سلام] فرمود: «آری، پسر سلام... امّا بیست‌ونه: خداوند ادریس (را به مکانی بلند برداشت».
57.en: Yes, O son of Salam... As for the twenty-nine, Allah raised Idris (peace be upon him) to a high place.
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 106

57.ar: فِیمَا احْتَجَّ بِهِ أَمِیرُالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) عَلَی یَهُودِیِّ الشَّامِ أَنَّ إِدْرِیسَ (علیه السلام)رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا وَ أُطْعِمَ مِنْ تُحَفِ الْجَنَّةِ بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ.
57.fa: امام علی (- درکتاب احتجاج آمده است که یهودی گفت: «ادریس (را خداوند به مقام عالی رسانید و از تحفه‌های بهشت پس از مرگ به او خورانید».
57.en: Among the arguments presented by Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) against the Jew of al-Sham is that God raised Idris (peace be upon him) to a high station, and he was fed from the gifts of Paradise after his death.
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 106

57.ar: أَبُوالْمَضَاءِ صَبِیحٌ مَوْلَی الرِّضَا (علیه السلام) قَالَ سَمِعْتُهُ یُحَدِّثُ عَنْ أَبِیهِ عَنْ جَدِّهِ فِی قَوْلِهِ تَعَالَی وَ رَفَعْناهُ مَکاناً عَلِیًّا قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِی صُعُودِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) عَلَی ظَهْرِ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لِقَلْعِ الصَّنَمِ.
57.fa: امام رضا (- ابوالمضاء صبیح گوید: «از امام رضا (شنیدم که از پدرش، از جدّش درباره‌ی سخن خدای تعالی: وَ رَفَعْناهُ مَکاناً عَلِیّاً حدیث نموده و فرمود: «[این آیه] درباره‌ی بالارفتن علی (بر پشت پیامبر (برای‌کندن بت‌ها نازل شده است».
57.en: Abu al-Mada’ Sabih, the mawla of al-Rida (peace be upon him), said: I heard him narrating from his father, from his grandfather, regarding the saying of the Exalted, "And We raised him to a high station" (19:57). He said: "It was revealed concerning the ascent of Ali (peace be upon him) onto the back of the Prophet (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) in order to uproot the idol."
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 106
57.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 38, p. 76; Al-Manaqib, Vol. 2, p. 135

57.ar: عَنِ الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) أَنَّ یَهُودِیّاً مِنْ یَهُودِ الشَّامِ وَ أَحْبَارِهِمْ کَانَ قَدْ قَرَأَ التَّوْرَاةَ وَ الْإِنْجِیلَ وَ الزَّبُورَ وَ صُحُفَ الْأَنْبِیَاءِ (وَ عَرَفَ دَلَائِلَهُمْ جَاءَ إِلَی مَجْلِسٍ فِیهِ أَصْحَابُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ فِیهِمْ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) ... قَالَ لَهُ الْیَهُودِیُّ فَإِنَّ هَذَا إِدْرِیسُ (علیه السلام) رَفَعَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مَکَاناً عَلِیّاً وَ أَطْعَمَهُ مِنْ تُحَفِ الْجَنَّةِ بَعْدَ وَفَاتِهِ قَالَ لَهُ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) لَقَدْ کَانَ کَذَلِکَ وَ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أُعْطِیَ مَا هُوَ أَفْضَلُ مِنْ هَذَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ قَالَ فِیهِ وَ رَفَعْنا لَکَ ذِکْرَکَ فَکَفَی بِهَذَا مِنَ اللَّهِ رِفْعَة.
57.en: Narrated from al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him): A Jew from the Jews of al-Sham, one of their scholars who had read the Torah, the Gospel, the Psalms, and the scriptures of the prophets and knew their signs, came to a gathering where the companions of the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) were present, among them Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him)... The Jew said to him, "As for this Idris (peace be upon him), Allah the Almighty raised him to a high place and fed him from the gifts of Paradise after his death." Ali (peace be upon him) said to him, "It was indeed so, but Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) was given that which is better than this. Allah, the Majestic is His praise, said regarding him: 'And We exalted your remembrance for you,' and this is sufficient as an exaltation from Allah."
57.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 106

58.ar: عَنْ عِیسَی بْنِ دَاوُدَ النَّجَّار عَنْ أَبِی الْحَسَنِ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عزّوجلّ أُولئِکَ الَّذِینَ أَنْعَمَ اللهُ عَلَیْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ آدَمَ وَ مِمَّنْ حَمَلْنا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ إِبْراهِیمَ وَ إِسْرائِیلَ وَ مِمَّنْ هَدَیْنا وَ اجْتَبَیْنا إِذا تُتْلی عَلَیْهِمْ آیاتُ الرَّحْمنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّداً وَ بُکِیًّا قَالَ نَحْنُ ذُرِّیَّةُ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (علیه السلام) وَ نَحْنُ الْمَحْمُولُونَ مَعَ نُوح (علیه السلام) وَ نَحْنُ صَفْوَةُ اللَّهِ وَ أَمَّا قَوْلُهُ وَ مِمَّنْ هَدَیْنا وَ اجْتَبَیْنا فَهُمْ وَ اللَّهِ شِیعَتُنَا الَّذِینَ هَدَاهُمُ اللَّهُ لِمَوَدَّتِنَا وَ اجْتَبَاهُمْ لِدِینِنَا فَحَیُّوا عَلَیْهِ وَ مَاتُوا عَلَیْهِ وَصَفَهُمُ اللَّهُ بِالْعِبَادَةِ وَ الْخُشُوعِ وَ رِقَّةِ الْقَلْبِ فَقَالَ إِذا تُتْلی عَلَیْهِمْ آیاتُ الرَّحْمنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّداً وَ بُکِیًّا ثُمَّ قَالَ عزّوجلّ فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا وَ هُوَ جَبَلٌ مِنْ صُفْرٍ یَدُورُ فِی وَسَطِ جَهَنَّمَ.
58.fa: امام کاظم (- عیسی‌بن‌داود نجّار گوید: از امام کاظم (در مورد آیه: أُولئِکَ الَّذِینَ أَنْعَمَ اللهُ عَلَیْهِمْ مِنَ النَّبِیِّینَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ آدَمَ وَ مِمَّنْ حَمَلْنا مَعَ نُوحٍ وَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ إِبْراهِیمَ وَ إِسْرائِیلَ وَ مِمَّنْ هَدَیْنا وَ اجْتَبَیْنا إِذا تُتْلی عَلَیْهِمْ آیاتُ الرَّحْمنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّداً وَ بُکِیًّا پرسیدم. ایشان فرمود: «ما نسل ابراهیم (و کسانی هستیم که به همراه نوح (بر روی کشتی سوار شدیم و ما برگزیدگان خداوندیم. امّا منظور از عبارت: وَمِمَّنْ هَدَیْنَا وَ اجْتَبَیْنَا ایشان - به خدا قسم - شیعیان مایند که خداوند آنان را به محبّت ما هدایت نمود و آنان را برای دین ما برگزید و با آن زندگی کردند و با آن مردند و خداوند آنان را با عبادت و خشوع و رقّت قلب توصیف نموده است». سپس فرمود: «إِذَا تُتْلَی عَلَیْهِمْ آیَاتُ الرَّحْمَن خَرُّوا سُجَّدًا وَبُکِیًّا سپس خداوند فرموده است: فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضَاعُوا الصَّلَاةَ وَاتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَوَاتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا؛ و آن کوهی از مس زرد است که در جهنّم می‌چرخد».
58.en: 'Isa ibn Dawud al-Najjar narrated that he asked Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "Those were the ones upon whom Allah bestowed favor from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel, and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping." He (peace be upon him) said: "We are the descendants of Abraham (peace be upon him), and we are those who were carried with Noah (peace be upon him), and we are the chosen ones of Allah. As for His saying: 'and of those whom We guided and chose,' by Allah, they are our Shia, whom Allah guided to our love and chose for our religion; they lived upon it and died upon it. Allah described them with worship, humility, and tenderness of heart, saying: 'When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.' Then the Almighty and Majestic said: 'But there came after them successors who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet Ghayy,' which is a mountain of yellow copper that rotates in the center of Hell."
58.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 108
58.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 23, p. 223; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 298; al-Burhan

58.ar: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: کَانَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ الْحُسَیْنِ (علیه السلام) یَسْجُدُ فِی سُورَةِ مَرْیَمَ حِینَ یَقُولُ وَ مِمَّنْ هَدَیْنا وَ اجْتَبَیْنا إِذا تُتْلی عَلَیْهِمْ آیاتُ الرَّحْمنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّداً وَ بُکِیًّا وَ یَقُولُ نَحْنُ عُنِینَا بِذَلِکَ وَ نَحْنُ أَهْلُ الْجَبْوَةِ وَ الصَّفْوَةِ.
58.fa: امام سجاد (- از امام باقر (روایت است: حضرت زین‌العابدین (وقتی به این آیه از سوره‌ی مریم می‌رسید: وَ مِمَّنْ هَدَیْنا وَ اجْتَبَیْنا إِذا تُتْلی عَلَیْهِمْ آیاتُ الرَّحْمنِ خَرُّوا سُجَّداً وَ بُکِیًّا سجده می‌کرد و می‌فرمود: «منظور ما هستیم که برگزیده و منتخب می‌باشیم».
58.en: Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) said: Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to prostrate when reciting in Surah Maryam: "And of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Gracious were recited to them, they fell down prostrating and weeping." He would say, "We are the ones meant by this, and we are the people of the choice and the elite."
58.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 108
58.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 148; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 298; Al-Burhan

59.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ وَ هُوَ الرَّدِیءُ وَ الدَّلِیلُ عَلَی ذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاهْ.
59.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- فَخَلَفَ مِن بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ؛ منظور از آن جانشینان بد است و دلیل آن، ادامه آیه است: أَضَاعُوا الصَّلَاة.
59.en: "Then there succeeded them a generation" (19:59), and this refers to the evil successors. The evidence for this is the continuation of the verse: "they neglected prayer."
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 108
59.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 11, p. 26 / Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 52; "with slight variation in wording" / Al-Burhan

59.ar: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ الْخَلْفُ الْبَدَلُ السَّیِّئُ أَیْ بَقِیَ بَعْدَ النَّبِیِّینَ الْمَذْکُورِینَ قَوْمُ سَوْءٍ مِنَ الْیَهُودِ وَ مَنْ تَبِعَهُمْ أَضاعُوا الصَّلَاةَ أَیْ تَرَکُوهَا أَوْ أَخَّرُوهَا عَنْ مَوَاقِیتِهَا.
59.fa: امام صادق (- فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ؛ الخَلَفَ جایگزین بد است؛ یعنی بعد از پیامبرانی که [در آیات قبلی] گفته شدند، قوم بدی - که یهود و پیروانشان است. - باقی ماندند؛ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ؛ یعنی نماز را رها کردند یا از وقتش به تأخیر انداختند.
59.en: "Then there succeeded them a generation" (fa-khalafa min ba'dihim khalf) — the 'khalf' is a bad replacement. This means that after the aforementioned prophets, a wicked people remained—the Jews and those who followed them. "They neglected prayer" (ada'u al-salah) — meaning they abandoned it or delayed it past its appointed times.
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 108
59.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 11, p. 17; Nur al-Thaqalayn; [with slight variations in wording]

59.ar: عَنْ دَاوُدَ بْنِ فَرْقَدٍ قَالَ: قُلْتُ لِأَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی إِنَّ الصَّلاةَ کانَتْ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ کِتاباً مَوْقُوتاً قَالَ کِتَاباً ثَابِتاً وَ لَیْسَ إِنْ عَجَّلْتَ قَلِیلًا أَوْ أَخَّرْتَ قَلِیلًا بِالَّذِی یَضُرُّکَ مَا لَمْ تُضَیِّعْ تِلْکَ الْإِضَاعَةَ فَإِنَّ اللَّهَ عزّوجلّ یَقُولُ لِقَوْمٍ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا.
59.en: Dawud ibn Farqad said: I asked Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) about the saying of the Almighty, "Indeed, prayer has been decreed upon the believers a decree of specified times." He said: "It is a fixed decree, and it is not the case that if you perform it a little early or a little late it will harm you, as long as you do not commit that [specific] neglect. For Allah, the Almighty and Majestic, says regarding a people who 'neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil.'"
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 108
59.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 3, p. 270; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 4, p. 29; Nur al-Thaqalayn

59.ar: یَا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ سَیَأْتِی مِنْ بَعْدِی أَقْوَامٌ یَأْکُلُونَ طَیِّبَ الطَّعَامِ وَ أَلْوَانَهَا وَ یَرْکَبُونَ الدَّوَابَّ وَ یَتَزَیَّنُونَ بِزِینَةِ الْمَرْأَةِ لِزَوْجِهَا وَ یَتَبَرَّجُونَ تَبَرُّجَ النِّسَاءِ وَ زِیُّهُنَّ مِثْلُ زِیِّ الْمُلُوکِ الْجَبَابِرَةِ وَ هُمْ مُنَافِقُو هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ فِی آخِرِ الزَّمَانِ شَارِبُونَ بِالْقَهَوَاتِ لَاعِبُونَ بِالْکِعَابِ رَاکِبُونَ الشَّهَوَاتِ تَارِکُونَ الْجَمَاعَاتِ رَاقِدُونَ عَنِ الْعَتَمَاتِ مُفْرِطُونَ فِی الْعَدَوَاتِ یَقُولُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا یَا ابْنَ مَسْعُودٍ مَثَلُهُمْ مِثْلُ الدِّفْلَی زَهْرَتُهَا حَسَنَةٌ وَ طَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ.
59.fa: پیامبر (- ای پسر مسعود: «گروهی پس از من می‌آیند که غذاهای رنگین و گوارا می‌خورند، چهار پایان را سوار می‌شوند، مانند زنان که برای شوهر آرایش می‌کنند آرایش می‌کنند آرایش خود را مانند زنان به دیگران نشان می‌دهند، لباسشان لباس پادشاهان ستمگر می‌باشد اینان در آخرالزمان منافقان امّتند؛ باده‌گساری می‌کنند، نرد ببازند، به فرمان هوی و هوس می‌باشند، اجتماع را وامی‌گذارند و نماز خفتن را نمی‌خوانند، زیاده‌روی در ستم می‌کنند و خدای تعالی می‌فرماید: فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا ای پسر مسعود مَثَل آنان مانند خرزهره است گلشن خوب مزه‌اش تلخ است.
59.en: O Ibn Mas’ud, there will come after me peoples who will eat fine and varied foods, ride beasts, adorn themselves with the adornments of a woman for her husband, and display their finery like the display of women. Their attire will be like the attire of tyrannical kings, and they are the hypocrites of this nation in the end times. They will be drinkers of intoxicants, players of dice, riders of desires, abandoners of congregational prayers, sleepers through the night prayers, and excessive in their hostilities. God Almighty says: "Then there succeeded them a generation who neglected prayer and followed desires, so they will meet destruction." O Ibn Mas’ud, their likeness is like the oleander: its flower is beautiful, but its taste is bitter.
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 110
59.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 74, p. 97; Makarim al-Akhlaq, p. 448 ("al-ghadawat" instead of "al-'adawat"); Wasa'il al-Shi'a, Vol. 15, p. 343; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 12, p. 327 ("yatarajjun" instead of "yatarajjun" and "tabarruj" is omitted).

59.ar: کِتَابُهُ (علیه السلام) إِلَی مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ مُسْلِمٍ الزُّهْرِی ... مَا لَکَ لَا تَنْتَبِهُ مِنْ نَعْسَتِکَ وَ تَسْتَقِیلُ مِنْ عَثْرَتِکَ فَتَقُولَ وَ اللَّهِ مَا قُمْتُ لِلَّهِ وَاحِداً أَحْیَیْتُ بِهِ لَهُ دِیناً أَوْ أَمَتُّ لَهُ فِیهِ بَاطِلًا فَهَذَا شُکْرُکَ مَنِ اسْتَحْمَلَکَ مَا أَخْوَفَنِی أَنْ تَکُونَ کَمَنْ قَالَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی فِی کِتَابِهِ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا اسْتَحْمَلَکَ کِتَابَهُ وَ اسْتَوْدَعَکَ عِلْمَهُ فَأَضَعْتَهَا فَنَحْمَدُ اللَّهَ الَّذِی عَافَانَا مِمَّا ابْتَلَاکَ بِه.
59.fa: امام سجّاد (- نامه‌ای که امام زین‌العابدین (به محمّدبن‌مسلم زهری می‌نویسد... تو را چه شده که از خواب غفلت بیدار نمی‌شوی و از لغزش خویش باز نمی‌ایستی تا بگویی: سوگند به خدا که من در تمام عمر خود یک بار هم نشد که به پا خیزم و محض رضای خدا، دین خدا را زنده سازم یا باطلی را بمیرانم. پس این است سپاسگزاری تو، از کسی که تأمین زندگی تو را به عهده گرفته است. چقدر بیمناکم که تو در شمار کسانی باشی که خداوند متعال در قرآن فرمود: أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا؛ خداوند قرآنش را در دسترس تو گذاشت و علم آن را به تو آموخت ولی تو آن را تباه ساختی. پس ما سپاس می‌گذاریم خداوندی را که ما را از آنچه تو به آن مبتلا گشتی محفوظمان داشت.
59.en: From his (peace be upon him) letter to Muhammad ibn Muslim al-Zuhri: ...What is the matter with you that you do not awaken from your slumber, and do not seek to rectify your stumbling, so that you might say: "By God, I have never once stood up for the sake of God to revive a religion for Him, nor have I put to death a falsehood for His sake." Is this your gratitude to the One who has taken upon Himself the burden of your livelihood? How I fear that you may be like those of whom God Almighty said in His Book: "They neglected the prayer and followed their desires, so they will soon meet perdition." He entrusted His Book to you and deposited His knowledge with you, yet you have squandered it. We praise God, who has spared us from that with which He has afflicted you.
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 110
59.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 75, p. 134; Tuhaf al-Uqul, p. 277

59.ar: أَبُومُحَمَّدٍ الْحُسَیْنُ بْنُ أَحْمَدَ الْمُکَتِّبُ قَالَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُوعَلِیِّ بْنُ هَمَّامٍ بِهَذَا الدُّعَاءِ وَ ذَکَرَ أَنَّ الشَّیْخَ الْعَمْرِیَّ قَدَّسَ اللَّهُ رُوحَهُ أَمْلَاهُ عَلَیْهِ وَ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ یَدْعُوَ بِهِ وَ هُوَ الدُّعَاءُ فِی غَیْبَةِ الْقَائِمِ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف): اللَّهُم ... وَ عَذِّبْ أَعْدَاءَکَ وَ أَعْدَاءَ دِینِکَ وَ أَعْدَاءَ رَسُولِکَ بِیَدِ وَلِیِّکَ وَ أَیْدِی عِبَادِکَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ اللَّهُمَّ اکْفِ وَلِیَّکَ وَ حُجَّتَکَ فِی أَرْضِکَ هَوْلَ عَدُوِّهِ وَ کِدْ مَنْ کَادَهُ وَ امْکُرْ بِمَنْ مَکَرَ بِهِ وَ اجْعَلْ دَائِرَةَ السَّوْءِ عَلَی مَنْ أَرَادَ بِهِ سُوءاً وَ اقْطَعْ عَنْهُ مَادَّتَهُمْ وَ أَرْعِبْ بِهِ قُلُوبَهُمْ وَ زَلْزِلْ لَهُ أَقْدَامَهُمْ وَ خُذْهُمْ جَهْرَةً وَ بَغْتَةً شَدِّدْ عَلَیْهِمْ عِقَابَکَ وَ أَخْزِهِمْ فِی عِبَادِکَ وَ الْعَنْهُمْ فِی بِلَادِکَ وَ أَسْکِنْهُمْ أَسْفَلَ نَارِکَ وَ أَحِطْ بِهِمْ أَشَدَّ عَذَابِکَ وَ أَصْلِهِمْ نَاراً وَ احْشُ قُبُورَ مَوْتَاهُمْ نَاراً وَ أَصْلِهِمْ حَرَّ نَارِکَ فَإِنَّهُمْ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ وَ أَذِلُّوا عِبَادَکَ.
59.fa: امام مهدی (- دعایی در غیبت امام مهدی (است: خدایا ولی و حجت خود را در زمینت از بیم دشمنش، کفایت فرما و هرکس به او نیرنگ زند، حیله کن و هرکس او را مکر کند، فریب ده، و کسانی که خواهان بدی برای او هستند در احاطه بدی قرار ده، اصل آنان را قطع کن و دلهایشان را به او بترسان و گامهایشان را برای او به لرزه درآور و آن‌ها را آشکارا یا پنهانی برگیر، عذابت را بر آنان بسیار کن و در میان بندگانت خوار ساز و آن‌ها را در سرزمین خود، نفرین کن و در پایینترنی نقطه آتش خود سکنی ده، و سختترین عذابت را بر آنان احاطه گردان و بر آتش جهنم وارد ساز. به راستی که آنان نماز را تباه کردند و از شهوتها پیروی نمودند و بندگانت را به خواری کشاندند.
59.en: Abu Muhammad al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Mukattib said: Abu Ali ibn Hammam narrated this supplication to us and mentioned that the Shaykh al-Amri (may Allah sanctify his soul) dictated it to him and commanded him to supplicate with it. It is the supplication during the occultation of the Qa’im (may Allah hasten his noble reappearance): "O Allah... and punish Your enemies, the enemies of Your religion, and the enemies of Your Messenger at the hands of Your Wali (Guardian) and the hands of Your believing servants. O Allah, protect Your Wali and Your Proof on Your earth from the terror of his enemy; plot against those who plot against him; deceive those who deceive him; bring the circle of evil upon those who intend evil for him; cut off their support for him; strike terror into their hearts through him; shake their footing for his sake; seize them openly and suddenly; intensify Your punishment upon them; disgrace them among Your servants; curse them in Your lands; lodge them in the lowest part of Your Fire; surround them with Your severest punishment; cast them into the Fire; fill the graves of their dead with fire; and subject them to the heat of Your Fire. For they have neglected prayer, followed their desires, and humiliated Your servants."
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 110

59.ar: مَنْ سَلِمَ مِنْ أُمَّتِی مِنْ أَرْبَعِ خِصَالٍ فَلَهُ الْجَنَّةُ مِنَ الدُّخُولِ فِی الدُّنْیَا وَ اتِّبَاعِ الْهَوَی وَ شَهْوَةِ الْبَطْنِ وَ شَهْوَةِ الْفَرْج.
59.fa: پیامبر (- اگر کسانی از امّت من دارای چهار خصلت باشند وارد بهشت می‌گردند، خود را به دنیا آلوده نکنند و هواپرستی نکنند، شکم خود را نگهدارند و دامن خود را حفظ نمایند.
59.en: Whoever among my nation is safe from four traits shall have Paradise: entering into [the pursuit of] the world, following desires, the appetite of the stomach, and the appetite of the private parts.
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 110

59.ar: وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ رَوَوْا عَنْ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) مَنْ بَنَی الشَّدِیدَ وَ رَکِبَ الْمَنْظُورَ وَ لَبِسَ الْمَشْهُورَ.
59.fa: امام علی (- وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ؛ کسی که بنای محکم بسازد و مورد پسند خود را سوار شود و لباس [شهرت و] گرانبها بپوشد.
59.en: "And they followed [their] desires." It is narrated from Ali (peace be upon him): "Whoever builds a sturdy structure, rides what is sought after, and wears famous [or ostentatious] clothing."
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 112

59.ar: مِنْ کَلَامِ أَمِیرِالْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) حِینَ قَدِمَ الْکُوفَةَ مِنَ الْبَصْرَةِ بَعْدَ حَمْدِ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی وَ الثَّنَاءِ عَلَیْهِ أَمَّا بَعْدُ فَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِی نَصَرَ وَلِیَّهُ وَ خَذَلَ عَدُوَّهُ وَ أَعَزَّ الصَّادِقَ الْمُحِقَّ وَ أَذَلَّ الْکَاذِبَ الْمُبْطِلَ عَلَیْکُمْ یَا أَهْلَ هَذَا الْمِصْرِ بِتَقْوَی اللَّهِ وَ طَاعَةِ مَنْ أَطَاعَ اللَّهَ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَیْتِ نَبِیِّکُمُ الَّذِینَ هُمْ أَوْلَی بِطَاعَتِکُمْ مِنَ الْمُنْتَحِلِینَ الْمُدَّعِینَ الْقَائِلِینَ إِلَیْنَا یَتَفَضَّلُونَ بِفَضْلِنَا وَ یُجَاحِدُونَّا أَمْرَنَا وَ یُنَازِعُونَّا حَقَّنَا وَ یَدْفَعُونَّا عَنْهُ وَ قَدْ ذَاقُوا وَبَالَ مَا اجْتَرَحُوا فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا قَدْ قَعَدَ عَنْ نُصْرَتِی مِنْکُمْ رِجَالٌ وَ أَنَا عَلَیْهِمْ عَاتِبٌ زَارٍ فَاهْجُرُوهُمْ وَ أَسْمِعُوهُمْ مَا یَکْرَهُونَ حَتَّی یُعْتِبُونَا وَ نَرَی مِنْهُمْ مَا نُحِبُّ.
59.fa: امام علی (- آنگاه که از بصره به کوفه آمد، پیش آمد تا بر منبر رفت، حمد و ثنای الهی بجای آورد سپس فرمود: امّا بعد، سپاس خدایی راست که دوستدار خود را یاری داد، و دشمن خویش را خوار ساخت و راستگوی طرفدار حق را عزّت بخشید، و دروغگوی باطل‌گرا را ذلیل نمود. ای ساکنان این شهر تقوای الهی پیشه کنید، و از طاعت آن گروه از اهل بیت پیامبرتان که خودشان خدا را اطاعت نموده‌اند جدا نشوید، آنان که در فرمانبری از ایشان - در آنچه که خودشان نیز خدا را فرمان برده‌اند - سزاوارترند از آن گروه افرادی که خود را به حقّ می‌بندند و مدّعی آنند و با ما مقابله می‌کنند، با فضل ما خود را صاحب فضل جلوه می‌دهند و همان فضل را در باره ما انکار می‌کنند، و در حقّ خودمان با ما می‌ستیزند و ما را از آن کنار می‌زنند، و البتّه و بال و گرفتاری اعمال زشت خود را چشیدند و بزودی به کیفر این تبهکاری (در آخرت) خواهند رسید. همانا مردانی چند از شما دست از یاری من برداشتند که من این کار زشت را بر آنان خرده می‌گیرم و آنان را مورد ملامت و سرزنش قرار می‌دهم، شما نیز از آن دوری کنید و به آنان بد بگوئید، و سخنان زننده‌ای به گوششان برسانید تا به جلب رضایت ما تن در دهند یا کاری که مورد خشنودی ماست از آنان مشاهده کنیم.
59.en: From the words of Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) when he arrived in Kufa from Basra: After praising and glorifying Allah the Exalted, he said: "To proceed: Praise be to Allah, who aided His ally, humiliated His enemy, honored the truthful one who is upon the truth, and debased the liar who is upon falsehood. O people of this city, I enjoin upon you the fear of Allah and obedience to those from the Household of your Prophet who obey Allah, for they are more deserving of your obedience than those who falsely claim it, who attribute themselves to us, who boast of our merit while denying our authority, who dispute our right and push us away from it. They have already tasted the consequences of what they have committed, and they shall soon encounter perdition. There are men among you who have held back from supporting me, and I am displeased and critical of them. So, shun them and let them hear what they dislike, until they seek to appease us and we see from them what we desire."
59.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 112
59.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 32, p. 351; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 32, p. 352 and Vol. 32, p. 354; the portion "There are men among you who have held back from supporting me... what we desire" is omitted in some versions.

59.ar: عِیسَی بْنِ دَاوُدَ النَّجَّارِ عَنْ أَبِی الْحَسَنِ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّه ... فَخَلَفَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِمْ خَلْفٌ أَضاعُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ اتَّبَعُوا الشَّهَواتِ فَسَوْفَ یَلْقَوْنَ غَیًّا وَ هُوَ جَبَلٌ مِنْ صُفْرٍ یَدُورُ فِی وَسَطِ جَهَنَّم ثُمَّ قَالَ عزّوجلّ إِلَّا مَنْ تابَ مَنْ غَشَّ آلَ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ آمَنَ وَ عَمِلَ صالِحاً فَأُولئِکَ یَدْخُلُونَ الْجَنَّةَ وَ لا یُظْلَمُونَ شَیْئاً إِلَی قَوْلِهِ مَنْ کانَ تَقِیًّا.
